title: The Stone Talisman
summary: A wounded Little Mink is hunted down for the Ancestral Stone, hides it, and vows to wait for its next heir. In Qingyang Town, Lin Dong's father Lin Xiao drinks away his days, crippled years ago at a Lin Clan competition by Lin Langtian's hidden blow. Lin Dong is called the son of trash and beaten by his cousins. He wakes with his wounds healed and a strange stone talisman in his hand. Inside a dream space in the talisman, a shadow shows him a ten-ring Tong Bei Fist, and copying it lifts him to Tempered Body 3rd layer. The next day Lin Shan bullies Qing Tan over a stalk of Chiyang Grass, and Lin Dong, now at Tempered Body 4th layer, fights back.
events: Little Mink is cornered in the Eastern Xuan Region, refuses to hand over the Ancestral Stone, and hides it for a future heir.
Lin Xiao drinks to forget being crippled by Lin Langtian; Liu Yan begs him to stop.
Lin Dong remembers the clan competition where Lin Langtian, a Yuan Dan genius of the inner clan, ruined his father.
Lin Dong is beaten and mocked as trash, then wakes healed with a stone talisman in his hand.
Qing Tan visits him at night, worried about Lin Shan and Lin Hong's bullying.
In the talisman's dream space Lin Dong copies a shadow's ten-ring Tong Bei Fist and reaches Tempered Body 3rd layer.
Lin Shan takes Qing Tan's Chiyang Grass; Lin Dong shows Tempered Body 4th layer and strikes back.
cultivation: Lin Dong rises from Tempered Body 2nd layer to 3rd and then 4th layer. In the flashback Lin Langtian reached Earthly Yuan at ten, Heavenly Yuan at twelve and Yuan Dan at fifteen; Lin Xiao was at Heavenly Yuan before he was crippled.

title: Lin Dong Wins the Clan Competition
summary: Lin Dong floors Lin Shan with a seven-ring Tong Bei Fist, and Lin Hong steps in, mocks the family and says he will win the clan competition and claim Qing Tan as his wife. Lin Xiao sees his son's progress and teaches him the Eight Desolation Palm. When Qing Tan's cold poison flares, the Stone Talisman absorbs the cold and condenses it into a bead. At the competition Lin Hong beats Qing Tan and is about to be named winner when Lin Dong arrives and challenges him. Lin Dong shows a ten-ring Tong Bei Fist, a better Eight Desolation Palm and Tempered Body 7th layer, and wins. The elders then plan for the Hunting Battle against the Lei and Xie families, while Lei Bao boasts that his son Lei Li has reached Earthly Yuan.
events: Lin Dong beats Lin Shan with a seven-ring Tong Bei Fist.
Lin Hong mocks Lin Xiao and says he will win Qing Tan at the clan competition.
Lin Xiao teaches Lin Dong the 2nd-grade Eight Desolation Palm.
The Stone Talisman draws out Qing Tan's cold poison and condenses it into a bead; she keeps the secret.
Lin Dong reaches Tempered Body 6th layer and arrives late to the competition.
Lin Hong defeats Qing Tan; Lin Dong challenges him and wins at Tempered Body 7th layer.
The elders choose Lin Dong for the Hunting Battle against the allied Lei and Xie families.
Lei Bao and Lei Li, now at Earthly Yuan, plan to crush him.
cultivation: Lin Dong reaches Tempered Body 6th layer and reveals Tempered Body 7th layer in the final. Lin Hong is at Tempered Body 7th layer. Lei Li has reached Earthly Yuan.

title: The Hunting Battle
summary: The Hunting Battle begins: each side must take a scale from a Fire Python Tiger, a beast as strong as a Heavenly Yuan fighter. Before it starts, Xie Yingying slaps Qing Tan and tries to take the Yin Pearl necklace Lin Dong gave her, and Lin Dong slaps her back, angering her fiancé Lei Li. In the forest Lin Dong agrees to work with Wu Yun, young master of the Raging Blade Dojo. Wu Yun grabs a scale but falls into Lei Li's trap, and Lei Li kicks him into the tiger's den; Lin Dong jumps in after him. Inside, the dying tigress turns out to be guarding two cubs, and Lin Dong picks the sickly one. Back in the arena Lei Bao stakes Ironwood Manor on a final duel between Lin Dong and Lei Li for the cubs, and Lin Dong accepts.
events: Lin Zhentian meets Luo Cheng, Lei Bao and Xie Qian at the Hunting Battle; the target is the Fire Python Tiger.
Xie Yingying bullies Qing Tan over her Yin Pearl necklace; Lin Dong slaps her and Lei Li threatens him.
Wu Yun steps in, then offers Lin Dong an alliance in the forest.
Lin Dong holds off Earthly Yuan Lei Li while Wu Yun takes a scale.
Lei Li traps Wu Yun and kicks him into the tiger's cave; Lin Dong jumps after him.
The tigress dies guarding two cubs; Wu Yun lets Lin Dong choose, and he takes the sickly one.
They return alive with the cubs; Lei Bao stakes Ironwood Manor on a duel with Lei Li for them.
cultivation: Lin Dong reached Tempered Body 9th layer half a month before the hunt. Lei Li is at Earthly Yuan. The Fire Python Tiger is equal to a Heavenly Yuan fighter.

title: Ironwood Manor and the Yang Yuan Vein
summary: In the duel for the cubs, Lei Li is shocked to find that Lin Dong has also reached Earthly Yuan, using the Yin Pearl's energy. Lei Li answers with the Ling Snake Palm, the 3rd-grade Thunderstorm Strike and the 4th-grade Rushing Thunder Light. Lin Dong blocks it with the Qimen Seal, a 3rd-grade fragment he mastered past its first layer, and wins Ironwood Manor for the Lin family. Months later the Lei family has wrecked the manor's woods and land before handing it over. Little Flame, now grown large, leads Lin Dong into a volcanic cave beneath it, where it eats a demon spirit and the Stone Talisman reacts to a strange flower. The cave holds a vein of Yang Yuan Stone, and Lin Dong refines Yang Yuan Pills with the talisman before the family heads to Yan City to sell the stones.
events: Lei Li finds Lin Dong is also at Earthly Yuan.
Lei Li uses Ling Snake Palm, Thunderstorm Strike and Rushing Thunder Light.
Lin Dong's Qimen Seal stops Rushing Thunder Light and he wins Ironwood Manor.
Lei Bao, about to reach Yuan Dan, vows revenge.
Lin Dong finds the manor ruined by the Lei family; Little Flame leads him to a lava cave.
Little Flame eats a demon spirit and the Stone Talisman reacts to a flower in the cave.
The family confirms a Yang Yuan Stone vein; Lin Zhentian hopes to reach Yuan Dan with it.
Lin Dong refines Yang Yuan Pills with the talisman and plans a trip to Yan City.
cultivation: Lin Dong has reached Earthly Yuan. Lei Bao is said to be close to Yuan Dan initial. Lin Zhentian hopes the Yang Yuan Stone will let him reach Yuan Dan.

title: Master Yan and Wu Sha
summary: Lin Dong goes with his grandfather and father to Yan City to sell Yang Yuan Stone in secret. At the Mysterious Objects Tower he trades nine Yang Yuan Pills for a Qiankun Bag and tries to buy an ancient divine wood fragment, but Zi Yue claims it. Her master, Master Yan, stops the quarrel with mental strength, explains Symbol Masters, invites Lin Dong to be his student and gives him a book. Lin Dong declines for now to protect the Stone Talisman's secret, then learns the Black Dragon Stockade has attacked the Lin family home and Ironwood Manor. At the manor he fights the second chief Wu Sha, a Heavenly Yuan fighter, while Qing Tan and Little Flame hold the gate. Beaten down with his Yuan Power spent, Lin Dong breaks through to Heavenly Yuan, kills Wu Sha, and Lei Bao vows to bring in outside help.
events: Lei Bao and Xie Qian learn the Lin family is selling Yang Yuan Stone and plot an attack.
Lin Dong buys a Qiankun Bag at the Mysterious Objects Tower for nine Yang Yuan Pills.
Zi Yue disputes the ancient wood fragment; Master Yan intervenes, offers to teach Lin Dong and gives him a book.
Lin Shan brings word that the Black Dragon Stockade has surrounded the Lin home.
Lin Dong rushes to Ironwood Manor and fights Wu Sha, who uses Wind-Tearing Hand and the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle.
Lin Dong uses the Qimen Seal up to its third layer, then breaks through to Heavenly Yuan.
Lin Dong kills Wu Sha; the Lei family is alarmed and Lei Bao plans to fetch a stronger ally.
cultivation: Wu Sha is at Heavenly Yuan. Lin Dong is at Earthly Yuan late, then breaks through to Heavenly Yuan during the fight. Lei Bao is close to Yuan Dan initial.

title: The Banquet and Gu Ying
summary: Using the Divine Movement Chapter, Lin Dong condenses a Destiny Symbol and becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian breaks through to Yuan Dan initial, and Lin Xiao has recovered to Heavenly Yuan. The Lei family invites the Lin family and Luo Cheng to a banquet, demands they join a merchant alliance under Lei Bao, and attacks when they refuse; Lei Bao reveals he too is at Yuan Dan initial. Gu Ying, vice-master of the Blood Cloth Sect and a 2nd Seal Symbol Master, joins the Lei side for a share of Ironwood Manor and pins everyone with mental strength. Lin Dong fights him with mental strength. When Gu Ying's Materialized Spirit Needle shatters the ancient wood's barrier, Lin Dong learns the Ancient Swirl Symbol from it, absorbs Gu Ying's Destiny Symbol and strikes him down.
events: Lin Dong becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master and can steer the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle with his mind.
Lin Zhentian forms a four-star Yuan Dan and explains the Yuan Dan stages.
The Lei family's banquet turns into an ambush; Lei Bao shows Yuan Dan initial.
Gu Ying of the Blood Cloth Sect sides with the Lei family for 60% of Ironwood Manor's income.
Gu Ying's mental pressure pins the Lin side; Lin Dong breaks free and fights him.
Gu Ying uses the Materialized Spirit Needle; Lin Dong blocks with the ancient wood.
The broken wood teaches Lin Dong the Ancient Swirl Symbol, which absorbs Gu Ying's Destiny Symbol.
Lin Dong attacks Gu Ying from behind and Lin Zhentian warns the Lei family.
cultivation: Lin Dong becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian reaches Yuan Dan initial with a four-star Yuan Dan. Lin Xiao is back at Heavenly Yuan. Lei Bao is at Yuan Dan initial. Gu Ying is a 2nd Seal Symbol Master.

title: The Wager with Wei Tong
summary: After the banquet the Lei and Xie families collapse, but the Blood Cloth Sect comes for revenge for Gu Ying. Its master Wei Tong, at Yuan Dan advanced, demands Gu Ying's killer, Ironwood Manor and the Lin family's submission. Lin Dong steps forward, flies out of reach with mental strength and threatens to vanish and train in secret if the sect attacks. He offers a wager instead, and Wei Tong agrees to a fight to the death at the Yan City arena in two months, with Blood Cloth Sect spies watching the family. Lin Dong sets out alone for Yan City with a hundred Yang Yuan Pills from his grandfather, leaving Wu Yun to watch over Qing Tan and Little Flame. He also needs a way to restore the Stone Talisman, whose power has faded, and he gets new clothes to enter the Thousand Gold Auction.
events: The Stone Talisman's power fails just as the Blood Cloth Sect reaches the Lin home.
Lin Zhentian sends Lin Ken and Lin Mang off with the juniors and faces Wei Tong.
Wei Tong demands Gu Ying's killer, Ironwood Manor and the Lin family's surrender.
Lin Dong admits killing Gu Ying and flies above the sect's archers with mental strength.
Lin Dong proposes a duel; Wei Tong sets it for two months later at the Yan City arena.
Lin Zhentian gives Lin Dong a hundred Yang Yuan Pills; Wu Yun promises to guard Qing Tan.
In Yan City Lin Dong buys new clothes to attend the Thousand Gold Auction.
cultivation: Wei Tong is at Yuan Dan advanced, said to match a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian is at Yuan Dan initial. Lin Dong is a 1st Seal Symbol Master and aims to reach the 2nd Seal in two months.

title: The Rat in the Stone Talisman
summary: At the Thousand Gold Auction Lin Dong sees Master Yan, now known as Yan City's strongest Symbol Master, and buys Void Spirit Grass for six hundred Yang Yuan Pills. The manager Xuan Su brings him to Master Yan and Zi Yue, and Lin Dong shows he has already condensed a Destiny Symbol. Master Yan explains that his Ancient Swirl Symbol is a rare Destiny Spirit Symbol with a power of absorption. Xuan Su asks him to fight for the Thousand Gold Association against the Blood Wolf Gang for a Celestial Dan Pool, and he agrees in exchange for a soak in the pool. Inside the Stone Talisman he meets Little Mink, a Celestial Demon Marten who hid there as a demon spirit. Little Mink explains that the talisman needs Yuan Power and that the pool can restore it, then leads him to a training place for Mental Strength.
events: Lin Dong keeps a low profile at the auction, where Master Yan sells the Autumn Scale Sword.
He buys Void Spirit Grass, and Master Yan and Zi Yue recognise his Mental Strength.
Xuan Su leads him to Master Yan and explains Yan City's three great powers.
Lin Dong shows his Destiny Symbol; Master Yan explains the three kinds of Destiny Symbol.
Xuan Su recruits him for the Celestial Dan Pool contest against the Blood Wolf Gang.
In the Stone Talisman he meets Little Mink, who absorbed the Fire Ancestral Phantom Flower's power to save him.
Little Mink says the talisman is drained for lack of Yuan Power and agrees to teach him.
Little Mink leads him to a place to train Mental Strength.
cultivation: Master Yan is a 4th Seal Symbol Master. Lin Dong has condensed a Destiny Symbol, and his Ancient Swirl Symbol is a Destiny Spirit Symbol.

title: The Celestial Dan Pool Contest
summary: Little Mink sets Lin Dong on the Mental Grindstone, which crushes and rebuilds his Mental Strength, and he lasts ten turns on the first try. On contest day Lin Dong meets Liu Yi and Xia Wanjin, the young-looking head of the Thousand Gold Association, who is at Yuan Dan perfect like Blood Wolf Gang leader Yue Shan. Zi Yue beats Yue Ling in the first round, but Yue Feng's Heavy Shadow Spear defeats Liu Yi. In the deciding round Lin Dong faces Jiang Li, a hired fighter at Heavenly Yuan late. Jiang Li uses the Blood Transformation Art to reach Yuan Dan for a short time. Lin Dong answers with Little Mink's Spiral Wave and wins the pool for the Thousand Gold Association.
events: Lin Dong survives the Mental Grindstone ten times; Little Mink promises him the Spiral Wave.
Twenty days before the Wei Tong duel, he meets Liu Yi and Xia Wanjin at the Thousand Gold Association.
At the pool, Yue Shan of the Blood Wolf Gang brings Yue Ling, Yue Feng and the hired Jiang Li.
Zi Yue defeats Yue Ling with mental strength.
Yue Feng beats Liu Yi with the Heavy Shadow Spear at its fourth level.
Jiang Li uses the Blood Transformation Art to reach Yuan Dan.
Lin Dong defeats him with the Spiral Wave, and Yue Shan accepts the loss.
cultivation: Xia Wanjin and Yue Shan are at Yuan Dan perfect. Zi Yue, Liu Yi, Yue Ling, Yue Feng and Jiang Li are at Heavenly Yuan late. Jiang Li briefly reaches Yuan Dan with the Blood Transformation Art. Lin Dong's mental strength is said to match a 2nd Seal Symbol Master.

title: Yin Yang Pearls
summary: The winners enter the Celestial Dan Pool to absorb its Yin and Yang energy. Lin Dong uses the Qingyuan Art his grandfather taught him, but it is far too slow, and Little Mink offers a better method in return for a favour. With the Qi-Transforming Spirit Vortex he absorbs a huge amount of energy, reaches Heavenly Yuan late and restores the Stone Talisman. At the bottom of the pool he finds the demon spirit of a wounded Demonic Jade Water Python guarding Yin Yang Pearls. Little Mink uses Lin Dong's Yuan Power to swallow it, then goes to sleep. Afterward Xia Wanjin makes Lin Dong an honorary elder of the Thousand Gold Association, and Xuan Su gives him the Three Yang Art to help him prepare for Wei Tong.
events: Lin Dong, Zi Yue and Liu Yi enter the Celestial Dan Pool.
Lin Dong uses the Qingyuan Art, which Lin Zhentian taught him, and absorbs too slowly.
Little Mink teaches him the Qi-Transforming Spirit Vortex, and he reaches Heavenly Yuan late.
At the pool bottom they find a Demonic Jade Water Python's demon spirit guarding Yin Yang Pearls.
Little Mink swallows the python spirit using Lin Dong's Yuan Power, then sleeps.
Lin Dong tells Xia Wanjin about the duel and becomes an honorary elder of the Thousand Gold Association.
Xuan Su gives him the Three Yang Art, which opens fifteen meridians.
cultivation: Lin Dong reaches Heavenly Yuan late. The python spirit is equal to Yuan Dan perfect even while wounded. Wei Tong is at Yuan Dan advanced.

title: Yuan Dan Before the Duel
summary: Five days before the duel, Lin Dong uses the Three Yang Art and the Stone Talisman to open twenty-two meridians. He then absorbs the Yin Yang Pearls and forms an eight-star Yuan Dan, double his grandfather's four stars, and also becomes a 2nd Seal Symbol Master. Xuan Su brings his grandfather, father and Qing Tan, who have quietly come to Yan City, and he shows Lin Xiao his new Yuan Dan initial strength. In the arena Wei Tong is shocked by Lin Dong's progress. Lin Dong holds his own with the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle and the Spiral Wave against Wei Tong's Thousand Crack Palm, even though a mental barrier stops him flying away. Then a Blood Wolf Gang Symbol Master seizes Qing Tan as a hostage, and Wei Tong strikes the distracted Lin Dong.
events: Lin Dong opens twenty-two meridians with the Three Yang Art and the Stone Talisman.
The Yin Yang Pearls give him an eight-star Yuan Dan at Yuan Dan initial; he also reaches the 2nd Seal.
Wu Yun escorts Qing Tan; the family reunites with Lin Dong in Yan City through Xuan Su.
Lin Dong tests his father with the Pure Yuan Finger, and Lin Xiao sees he is at Yuan Dan initial.
The duel begins at the Yan City arena, watched by Yue Shan and Xia Wanjin.
Wei Tong uses Breaking Kill Fist and Thousand Crack Palm; Lin Dong answers with the shuttle and Spiral Wave.
A Blood Wolf Gang Symbol Master takes Qing Tan hostage, and Wei Tong strikes Lin Dong.
cultivation: Lin Dong forms an eight-star Yuan Dan and reaches Yuan Dan initial; he also becomes a 2nd Seal Symbol Master, with mental strength said to match a 3rd Seal. Wei Tong is at Yuan Dan advanced.

title: The Death of Wei Tong
summary: With Qing Tan held hostage, Lin Dong takes Wei Tong's Thousand Crack Palm head-on while Master Yan goes to free his family. Lin Dong hides a Materialized Spirit Needle inside his Spiral Wave, breaks through the arena's mental barrier and kills the Symbol Master holding Qing Tan. Free to fight, he hits Wei Tong with the fourth layer of the Qimen Seal, and Wei Tong begs to surrender. Lin Dong kills him anyway for what he did to his family, and Xia Wanjin stops Yue Shan from stepping in. The Lin family settles into a large house in northern Yan City with the Thousand Gold Association's help. Xia Wanjin tells Qing Tan about events in the Heavenly Yuan Mountains. Master Yan then tells Lin Dong about the ranks beyond the 5th Seal and the Symbol Master Tower, and talk turns to the tomb of a Nirvana-stage expert.
events: Wei Tong presses Lin Dong while Qing Tan is held hostage; Master Yan goes to rescue the family.
Lin Dong hides a Materialized Spirit Needle in his Spiral Wave and kills the hostage-taker.
Lin Dong hits Wei Tong with the fourth layer of the Qimen Seal.
Wei Tong surrenders, but Lin Dong kills him; Xia Wanjin holds back Yue Shan.
The Lin family moves into a large house in Yan City.
Xia Wanjin leaves Void Spirit Grass for Lin Dong and mentions the Heavenly Yuan Mountains.
Master Yan explains the Spirit Symbol Master rank and the Symbol Master Tower.
Talk turns to a Nirvana-stage expert's tomb and a Nirvana Heart.
cultivation: Lin Dong is a 2nd Seal Symbol Master. Master Yan is a 4th Seal Symbol Master and names the Spirit Symbol Master as the rank after the 5th Seal.

title: Ambush on the Road and the Tower Battle Challenge
summary: Masked raiders ambush a Lin Family convoy carrying Yang Yuan Stones from Ironwood Manor, and Lin Dong holds them off with the Qimen Seal while Lin Hong leads everyone home. Lin Zhentian decides the family is being targeted and halts the shipments, since the Lin Family is still new and weak in Yan City. Lin Dong fails again to become a 3rd Seal Symbol Master, and Qing Tan hides that her hands are cold again. Master Yan asks him to join Zi Yue in the Tower Battle, because the Yan City Symbol Master Guild has lost the Symbol Master Tower contest to Sky Fire City twice in a row. At the guild, Sky Fire City disciple Cao Zhu humiliates the local symbol masters, and Lin Dong beats him when his Destiny Symbol swallows Cao Zhu's mental attacks. Lin Dong keeps Cao Zhu's Mysterious Ice Swords as a prize and finds his own Mental Strength has grown.
events: Raiders ambush the Lin Family's Yang Yuan Stone convoy; Lin Dong covers Lin Hong's retreat with the Qimen Seal.
Lin Zhentian suspends shipments from Ironwood Manor and tells the family to keep a low profile.
Lin Dong fails to reach 3rd Seal Symbol Master; Qing Tan's hands are cold, but she denies the cold poison is back.
Zi Yue tests Lin Dong at the Symbol Master Guild before Master Yan stops the fight.
Master Yan explains the Tower Battle against Sky Fire City and the Qi-grade Secret Spirit Skill said to lie on the tower's eighth floor.
Sky Fire City's master sends Cao Zhu ahead to probe Yan City's young symbol masters, with Zhou Tong as his main hope.
Lin Dong defeats Cao Zhu; his Destiny Symbol absorbs Cao Zhu's mental power, and he takes the Mysterious Ice Swords.
Cao Zhu reports back to his master and to Zhou Tong.
introduced: Han Yun (on screen, not yet named)
cultivation: Lin Dong is a 2nd Seal Symbol Master and fails again to become a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Zhou Tong is at the peak of 2nd Seal Symbol Master. Cao Zhu is a 2nd Seal Symbol Master.

title: The Tower Battle Begins
summary: Zi Yue escorts Lin Dong to the Symbol Master Guild on the day of the Tower Battle. Liu Long, Cao Zhu's senior brother, demands the Mysterious Ice Swords back, and Lin Dong refuses. Sky Fire City's leader Han Yun, a 4th Seal Symbol Master like Master Yan, mocks Lin Dong as a last-minute newcomer with only half a year of training. The Symbol Master Tower opens, and its pressure stops some entrants on the first floor, while each floor Lin Dong climbs makes his Mental Strength grow. On the fifth floor Liu Long and Cao Zhu ambush him and demand the swords, 20,000 Yang Yuan Stones and an apology. Lin Dong defeats them even after they merge their spirits, his Ancient Swirl Symbol drinks the mental power off their swords, and he takes Liu Long's Lihuo Sword before climbing on.
events: Zi Yue brings Lin Dong to the guild; Zhou Tong is pointed out as the one who won the last two Tower Battles.
Liu Long introduces himself and asks for Cao Zhu's Mysterious Ice Swords; Zi Yue backs Lin Dong.
Han Yun and Master Yan trade words, and the Symbol Master Tower is opened.
Lin Dong climbs fast, gaining Mental Strength on each floor, while Zhou Tong pulls ahead.
Liu Long and Cao Zhu wait on the fifth floor to beat Lin Dong and take the swords.
Lin Dong controls three Mysterious Ice Swords and the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle at once; the pair merge their spirits and attack with the Lihuo Sword.
His Destiny Symbol absorbs the mental power on their swords; he wins and keeps the Lihuo Sword.
Han Yun expects Zhou Tong and Zi Yue to be the two on the sixth floor; Master Yan says the surprise comes last.
cultivation: Han Yun is a 4th Seal Symbol Master, like Master Yan. Zhou Tong is called a 2nd Seal Symbol Master at the peak.

title: Onto the Eighth Floor
summary: Zhou Tong, now a 3rd Seal Symbol Master, reaches the seventh floor of the Symbol Master Tower and leaves Zi Yue stuck on the sixth. Lin Dong passes her and breaks through to the seventh floor, where he and Zhou Tong fight with Mental Arrows, the Qimen Seal and a Ten Thousand Arrows Formation. Before the eighth floor, lightning snakes strike their Destiny Symbols, and Zhou Tong stops to save his own. Lin Dong pushes on, lets his Destiny Symbol devour the lightning's mental power, and becomes the first to reach the eighth floor in many years. There he finds the Qi-grade Huasheng Symbol Formation, but his Mental Strength is still too weak to use it. Meanwhile intruders strike Ironwood Manor and scout the Lin Family. Zi Yue and Zhou Tong leave the tower, Zhou Tong admits Lin Dong won, and Sky Fire City goes home.
events: Zhou Tong enters the seventh floor and tells Zi Yue that Yan City will lose again.
Lin Dong reaches the sixth floor, takes over from Zi Yue, and also breaks through to the seventh.
Lin Dong and Zhou Tong duel on the seventh floor and race for the eighth.
Lightning snakes attack their Destiny Symbols; Zhou Tong pulls back to repair his.
Lin Dong refuses to quit; his Destiny Symbol devours the lightning snakes' mental power and he enters the eighth floor.
Intruders break into Ironwood Manor and watch the Lin Family; Lin Zhentian keeps everyone home and does not call Lin Dong back.
On the eighth floor Lin Dong finds the Huasheng Symbol Formation and decides to try for 3rd Seal there.
Zhou Tong comes out and admits defeat; Yan City keeps the Symbol Master Tower and Sky Fire City leaves.
introduced: Huasheng Symbol Formation (Huasheng Light, Huasheng Blue Wave, Myriad Transformation Flame)
cultivation: Zhou Tong is a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Lin Dong is still a 2nd Seal Symbol Master and reaches the eighth floor, which even 3rd Seal Symbol Masters rarely reach.

title: The Hidden Space and Gui Yan
summary: After 24 days on the eighth floor, Lin Dong becomes a 3rd Seal Symbol Master and uses Huasheng Light for the first time. His Destiny Symbol is pulled into the tower's legendary hidden space, where Little Mink finally wakes, with a new colour that it calls its true form. Little Mink explains the eight Ancestral Symbols, formed by the rules of heaven and earth, and says the room holds only a rubbing of one. The rubbing gives Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol a map of the Great Yan Dynasty showing the locations of two Ancestral Symbols, which Little Mink tells him to keep secret. Qing Tan arrives at the guild to say masked men are attacking the Lin Family. At home, Ghost Blade Sect leader Gui Yan forces Lin Zhentian to hand over the Yang Yuan Stone vein and then tries to kill everyone. Lin Dong kills Gui Yan with Huasheng Light, and the Lin Family no longer fears anyone in Yan City.
events: Master Yan waits 24 days while Lin Dong breaks through to 3rd Seal Symbol Master on the eighth floor.
Lin Dong tests Huasheng Light; his Destiny Symbol is drawn into a hidden space no one had entered in a hundred years.
Little Mink wakes up and explains the eight Ancestral Symbols.
An Ancestral Symbol rubbing marks two Ancestral Symbol locations on a map of the Great Yan Dynasty in Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol.
Qing Tan reaches the guild with news of an attack; Lin Dong leaves with Zi Yue.
Gui Yan takes the Yang Yuan Stone vein from Lin Zhentian, then tries to wipe out the Lin Family.
Lin Dong fights Gui Yan and kills him with Huasheng Light; the Ghost Blade Sect men flee.
cultivation: Lin Dong becomes a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. Gui Yan is called Yan City's strongest at Yuan Dan advanced.

title: Qing Tan's Fiend Devil Body
summary: With Gui Yan dead, the Lin Family is secure in Yan City, and Lin Dong trains for the Lin Clan Gathering two years away. Qing Tan's cold poison flares, and Little Mink explains that she has a Fiend Devil Body, which rejects Yang energy and must condense a Yin Dan instead of a Yuan Dan. Without a very Yin treasure to speed this up, she could lose her mind. At the Thousand Gold Association, Xuan Su gives Lin Dong a Blood Vermillion Devil Fruit for becoming a 3rd Seal Symbol Master. She also tells him about a Nirvana expert's ancient tomb found in the Sky Flame Mountain Range, which may hold Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva. Lin Dong humiliates Lin Chen, a bullying Lin Clan youth, and so wins Lin Ke-er's permission to join the clan's tomb party. That night he eats the fruit and reaches Yuan Dan advanced.
events: The Lin Family settles in Yan City; Lin Dong vows to beat Lin Langtian and bring the family back to the clan.
Lin Zhentian hears the Lin Clan is sending people to the Sky Flame Mountain Range.
Qing Tan's cold poison flares; Little Mink names her Fiend Devil Body and says she needs a very Yin treasure to form a Yin Dan.
Xuan Su gives Lin Dong a Blood Vermillion Devil Fruit and tells him about the Nirvana tomb and Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva.
Little Mink explains the Nirvana Heart and agrees to help, if Lin Dong helps it seize things that restore its demon spirit.
Lin Chen beats Lin Hong; Lin Dong beats Lin Chen with the Mysterious Ice Swords and the Qimen Seal.
Lin Ke-er agrees to take Lin Dong to the tomb.
Lin Dong eats the Blood Vermillion Devil Fruit and reaches Yuan Dan advanced.
cultivation: Lin Dong reaches Yuan Dan advanced after eating the Blood Vermillion Devil Fruit. Lin Chen is Yuan Dan advanced.

title: Gathering at the Ancient Tomb
summary: Lin Ke-er's party sets out into the Sky Flame Mountain Range with Lin Dong, Little Flame and the boastful Lin Chen. Lin Ke-er explains that only experts of the three Creation realms can break the tomb's seal, and that the clan's young representative Lin Langtian will come to do it. At night, Song Dao of the Blade Slaughter Gang raids the camp, and Lin Ke-er cuts down his men with a Soul Treasure sword. Lin Dong beats Song Dao, a Yuan Dan perfect fighter, with the Qimen Seal and Myriad Transformation Flame, and with Little Mink's help breaks the Yuan Dan he throws. At the tomb, the Wang Clan's Wang Pan and Wang Yan, the Qin Clan's Qin Shi, and Lin Langtian, flying in at Qi Creation, gather. Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace comes for the Huangpu Clan, and the young experts break the seal together. Everyone rushes into the tomb after the Nirvana Heart.
events: Lin Dong leaves home for the tomb with Lin Ke-er's party, including Lin Chen.
Lin Ke-er says only experts of the three Creation realms can break the seal, and Lin Langtian will come.
Song Dao's Blade Slaughter Gang raids the camp; Lin Ke-er's Soul Treasure sword kills his men.
Lin Dong defeats Song Dao and shatters his Yuan Dan, leaving him crippled.
Lin Ke-er scolds Lin Chen for looking down on side-branch members.
At the tomb camp, Wang Pan, Lin Langtian, Wang Yan and Qin Shi arrive; Lin Dong sees how far behind he is.
Ling Qingzhu arrives for the Huangpu Clan; the seal is broken and everyone rushes in.
cultivation: Song Dao is Yuan Dan perfect, and Lin Dong is Yuan Dan advanced. Lin Langtian is already at Qi Creation. Wang Yan and Qin Shi are at Form Creation.

title: Pure Yuan Pills and the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd
summary: Inside the ancient tomb, Little Mink leads Lin Dong away from the crowd and down a side passage. Lin Dong opens a stone door with Mental Strength and finds a hoard of Pure Yuan Pills, 23,000 in all, while Little Mink eats a store of Demon Spirits that it says will restore half its strength. They seal a jade door behind them, escape through a back way, and leave pursuers to a demon beast. Lin Ke-er and Wang Pan agree to break open six Soul Treasures together, but Wang Pan plans to betray her. When the seal breaks, Lin Dong takes the half-finished spear-shaped treasure Little Mink chose and binds it with his blood essence: the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd. Wang Pan attacks him for it, and Lin Ke-er protects Lin Dong as a member of the Lin Clan. Lin Dong then goes off alone to look for the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva.
events: The young experts scatter into the tomb past the tomb master's statue.
Little Mink sniffs out a sealed room; Lin Dong opens it with Mental Strength and collects Pure Yuan Pills in his Qiankun Bag.
Little Mink devours a store of Demon Spirits.
Lin Dong holds the jade door shut with Mental Strength, then escapes and leaves the looters to a demon beast.
Lin Ke-er and Wang Pan agree to break open six Soul Treasures and split them; Wang Pan secretly orders his men to rob the Lin side.
Lin Dong snatches the spear-shaped Soul Treasure, outruns two Yuan Dan perfect pursuers and binds it with blood essence.
Wang Pan demands it back; Lin Ke-er stands up for Lin Dong.
Lin Dong leaves Lin Ke-er's group to search for the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva.
cultivation: Two of Wang Pan's men chasing Lin Dong are Yuan Dan perfect. No new realm is stated for Lin Dong.

title: Symbol Puppets and the Sea of Fire
summary: Little Mink leads Lin Dong and Little Flame through a maze formation whose stone walls close in. They escape by running straight at what looks like a dead end. Beyond it lie wrecked low-grade Symbol Puppets and an icy lake, and Lin Dong uses Mental Strength to take the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva for Qing Tan. A working low-grade Symbol Puppet attacks, and Lin Dong destroys it by striking the symbol formation on its body with Myriad Transformation Flame and the Mysterious Ice Swords. He then binds an intact mid-grade Symbol Puppet, said to rival the three Creation realms, though each strike costs 2,000 Pure Yuan Pills. Leaving Little Flame behind, Lin Dong and Little Mink cross a sea of fire full of fire dragons and jump into the lava, which turns out to be an illusion. They pass Lin Langtian trapped in the formation and reach the tomb master's palace and the Nirvana Heart, where a voice warns Lin Dong off.
events: The maze formation's walls close in; Lin Dong escapes by trusting the path that looks false.
He finds broken low-grade Symbol Puppets and learns that Mental Strength can make one obey.
Lin Dong collects the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva from an icy lake with Mental Strength.
A low-grade Symbol Puppet attacks; he destroys it by hitting its symbol formation.
He binds an intact mid-grade Symbol Puppet that runs on 2,000 Pure Yuan Pills per strike.
In the sea of fire, Lin Dong kills fire dragons with Myriad Transformation Flame and the halberd, then jumps into the illusory lava.
He sees Lin Langtian stuck in the formation and reaches the tomb master's palace and the Nirvana Heart.
cultivation: A low-grade Symbol Puppet can easily kill a Yuan Dan perfect fighter. A mid-grade Symbol Puppet rivals the three Creation realms, and one strike equals a Form Creation expert's.

title: The Nirvana Heart
summary: In the tomb master's palace, Ling Qingzhu tells Lin Dong the Nirvana Heart is not for him, and he says he only came to see it. She opens its seal with ease and starts absorbing it, while Lin Dong bows at the coffin and reads the tomb master's last words. The master chose cultivation over the woman he loved, so his legacy can only be absorbed by two people who love each other. The Nirvana power backlashes, and Ling Qingzhu asks for Lin Dong's Yuan Dan and tries to take it by force when he refuses. The tomb master's remnant soul then appears, angry at the shattered coffin, and attacks her. Lin Dong begs him to spare her, and the master pushes the two of them together into the Nirvana power so they absorb it as a pair. As thanks for the bow, the master also teaches Lin Dong the technique of the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd, and outside, the great formation lifts for Lin Langtian's group.
events: Ling Qingzhu meets Lin Dong at the Nirvana Heart; he says he will not compete and she gives her name.
She breaks the Nirvana Heart's seal and begins absorbing it.
Lin Dong bows at the tomb master's coffin and reads that his legacy needs two people with feelings for each other.
The Nirvana power backlashes; Ling Qingzhu asks for Lin Dong's Yuan Dan, he refuses, and she attacks.
The tomb master's remnant soul appears and overpowers Ling Qingzhu.
Lin Dong pleads for her; the master forces them to absorb the Nirvana power together.
The master teaches Lin Dong the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd technique.
The great formation opens, and Lin Langtian's group heads for the main chamber.
cultivation: Lin Dong and Ling Qingzhu absorb the Nirvana Heart's power together. No realm is stated this episode.

title: Lin Langtian's Pressure
summary: Lin Dong wakes at Yuan Dan perfect, and the furious Ling Qingzhu attacks him for disgracing her but stops short of killing him. Qin Shi, Wang Yan and Lin Langtian break in, see that the Nirvana Heart is taken, and Ling Qingzhu turns aside Wang Yan's invitation and leaves. Wang Yan accuses Lin Dong of stealing the Wang Clan's Soul Treasure, and Lin Ke-er says Wang Pan is lying. Lin Langtian learns Lin Dong is from a side branch and orders him to hand the halberd to Wang Yan and apologize to Wang Pan. When Lin Dong refuses, Lin Langtian offers to forget it if Lin Dong can walk out of the main hall under his Qi Creation pressure. Thinking of Qing Tan and his family, Lin Dong crawls and stands through the pressure and makes it out. He swears to repay this a hundredfold, and Lin Langtian admits this ant is not ordinary.
events: Lin Dong finds he is Yuan Dan perfect; Ling Qingzhu attacks him for what happened in the tomb.
Qin Shi, Wang Yan and Lin Langtian arrive; Ling Qingzhu downplays the fight.
Ling Qingzhu turns down Wang Yan's invitation and leaves after Lin Dong concedes a rematch.
Wang Yan and Wang Pan claim the Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd; Lin Ke-er and others back Lin Dong.
Lin Langtian orders Lin Dong to give up the halberd and apologize; Lin Dong refuses.
Lin Langtian dares him to walk out of the main hall under his Qi Creation pressure.
Lin Dong pushes through the pressure and walks out, vowing revenge.
cultivation: Lin Dong is now Yuan Dan perfect. Lin Langtian is at Qi Creation.

title: Wang Yan's Ambush
summary: Lin Dong recovers outside the tomb, and Little Mink praises him for not throwing his life away against Lin Langtian, since staying alive is how the Lin Family can rise again. Lin Dong vows to beat Lin Langtian at the Lin Clan Gathering in two years and decides to hunt for the Ancestral Symbols. Little Mink tells him a story from the Celestial Demon Marten records: one supreme expert who held all eight Ancestral Symbols once stopped a great catastrophe, then vanished with them. On the way back to Yan City, Wang Yan ambushes him for the halberd, and Lin Dong sends Little Flame ahead with the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva. Against Wang Yan's Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and Great Luo Golden Spear, Lin Dong uses the Fish Scale Halberd and Python Scale Halberd moves of the Heavenly Scales Halberd Art. He then hits Wang Yan with the mid-grade Symbol Puppet. He pins Wang Yan and takes his high-grade Qiankun Bag, but Wang Yan's guardian Elder Shen appears.
events: Lin Dong wakes in the mountains; Little Mink explains why surviving mattered more than fighting.
Lin Dong resolves to beat Lin Langtian in two years and to seek the Ancestral Symbols.
Little Mink tells the legend of the supreme expert who held all eight Ancestral Symbols.
Wang Yan ambushes Lin Dong; Little Flame escapes with the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva.
Lin Dong uses Myriad Transformation Flame and the halberd's Fish Scale Halberd and Python Scale Halberd against Wang Yan.
Wang Yan's Great Luo Golden Spear and White Dragon Roar overpower him until the Symbol Puppet strikes.
Lin Dong pins Wang Yan and takes his high-grade Qiankun Bag.
Elder Shen arrives to protect Wang Yan.
introduced: Heavenly Scales Halberd Art (Fish Scale Halberd, Python Scale Halberd)
cultivation: Wang Yan is at Form Creation. Lin Langtian is at Qi Creation.

title: Qing Tan's Yin Dan and the Road to Great Desolate Province
summary: Elder Shen attacks, and Little Mink spends its newly restored power through the Stone Talisman, using Pure Yuan Pills, to hold him off and tells Lin Dong to run. When Elder Shen's Black Light Blade is about to kill him, Ling Qingzhu saves him, and Wang Yan calls Elder Shen off. She makes Lin Dong swear never to speak of the tomb and warns that the secret could destroy even the Lin Clan. When he says he will one day be worthy of her, she tells him to first earn a place in the Hundred Dynasties Battle. Back in Yan City, Lin Dong uses the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva to help Qing Tan condense her Yin Dan. He burns away the Fiend Devil Qi with Myriad Transformation Flame until Qing Tan masters it herself. Her cold poison is gone, she leaps to Yuan Dan perfect, and Lin Dong sets out for Great Desolate Province, promising to return for the Lin Clan Gathering in two years.
events: Elder Shen attacks; Little Mink burns its restored power through the Stone Talisman to blunt him.
Lin Dong uses the halberd against Elder Shen's Black Light Blade and is nearly killed.
Ling Qingzhu saves Lin Dong; Wang Yan tells Elder Shen not to chase.
Ling Qingzhu swears Lin Dong to secrecy and mentions the Hundred Dynasties Battle.
In Yan City, Lin Dong uses the Extreme Yin Dragon Saliva to help Qing Tan form her Yin Dan.
The Fiend Devil Qi takes shape; Lin Dong drives it back with Myriad Transformation Flame, and Qing Tan subdues it.
Qing Tan's cold poison is cured and she breaks through to Yuan Dan perfect.
Lin Dong leaves Yan City for Great Desolate Province.
cultivation: Qing Tan condenses her Yin Dan and breaks through to Yuan Dan perfect at once.

title: The Thunder Source
summary: On the road to Great Desolate Province, Lin Dong trains the Great Sun Thunder Body and calls down lightning on a snowy peak, but one meridian is still closed, so he cannot form the Copper Thunder Body. Di Yun of the Di Family tries to catch Little Flame, and when Lin Dong steps in, Di Yun attacks him with his Green Yuan Spear. Lin Dong takes the spear. Di Teng, Di Yun's father, is at Form Creation advanced, and he pays Lin Dong 20,000 Pure Yuan Pills to get it back. Lin Dong overhears that Di Teng is hunting a Thunder Source Crystal Beast, whose Thunder Source could finish his Copper Thunder Body. He follows the Di Family. When the beast breaks through that night, he snatches the Thunder Source from under Di Teng's nose.
events: Lin Dong and Little Flame kill Devil Alligator Leopards while he trains the Great Sun Thunder Body.
He draws down lightning on a snowy peak, and his Destiny Symbol absorbs it, but the Copper Thunder Body still will not form.
Di Yun's men tie up Little Flame; Lin Dong frees it, refuses to sell it, beats Di Yun and takes his Green Yuan Spear.
Di Teng arrives and pays 20,000 Pure Yuan Pills for the spear; Lin Dong leaves without giving his name.
Little Mink explains that the Thunder Source Crystal Beast is weak right after it advances, and that its Thunder Source can complete the Copper Thunder Body.
That night the beast advances, Di Teng fights it, and Lin Dong grabs the Thunder Source and runs.
cultivation: Lin Dong is close to Form Creation (Di Teng). Di Teng is Form Creation advanced and wants the Thunder Source to reach Qi Creation. The Thunder Source Crystal Beast is as strong as a Qi Creation expert. Little Mink is still far from the Manifestation realms.

title: Copper Thunder Body
summary: Di Teng chases Lin Dong through the forest for the Thunder Source, then seals off the woods. Lin Dong finds Little Flame lying beside the dead Thunder Source Crystal Beast, whose essence is reshaping its body. While Little Flame recovers, Lin Dong refines the Thunder Source, forms the Copper Thunder Body and breaks through to Form Creation. Di Teng teams up with his rival Liu Kui, another Form Creation expert, but Lin Dong holds them off with his halberd and reveals that he is a 4th Seal Symbol Master. Little Flame wakes up evolved and turns the fight, and the two old men pay Lin Dong 100,000 Pure Yuan Pills each to let them go. At the edge of Great Desolate Province he gets lost in a misty forest and saves a little girl from a beast.
events: Lin Dong escapes Di Teng, who sends everyone to search the forest.
Little Flame has killed the Thunder Source Crystal Beast, and the beast's essence is reshaping its body.
Lin Dong hides and refines the Thunder Source, forming the Copper Thunder Body and reaching Form Creation.
Liu Kui appears and agrees to help Di Teng in exchange for a share of the Thunder Source.
Lin Dong fights both of them with his halberd arts and a Huasheng Symbol Formation, showing he is a 4th Seal Symbol Master.
Little Flame wakes up evolved; Di Teng and Liu Kui give up and pay 100,000 Pure Yuan Pills each.
Lost in a misty forest for two days, Lin Dong saves a little girl from a beast.
cultivation: Lin Dong refines the Thunder Source, forms the Copper Thunder Body (first layer of the Great Sun Thunder Body) and breaks through to Form Creation. He is a 4th Seal Symbol Master. Di Teng and Liu Kui are both Form Creation. Little Mink expects the evolved Little Flame to reach at least Form Creation. Di Teng judges that Lin Dong can stand up to Form Creation peak fighters.

title: Eagle Martial Dojo
summary: The girl Lin Dong saved is Jiang Yinyin, and her father Jiang Lei runs the Eagle Martial Dojo in Eagle City. Jiang Lei agrees to guide Lin Dong out of the Mist Forest, gives him new clothes, and tells him about the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet: the ruins of an ancient sect whose seal weakens every three years. That night the Mist Leopard Alligator King, angry that the dojo killed its cub, attacks with its beasts. Lin Dong drives off two Form Creation beasts with his fists, the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and his halberd. In Eagle City, Luo Shan of the Bloody Vulture Dojo brings his father Luo Jiu's challenge to a fight to the death and harasses Jiang Xue, so Lin Dong beats him. Jiang Lei is only Form Creation advanced, while Luo Jiu has reached Form Creation peak. That night Jiang Xue comes to Lin Dong and begs him to fight in her father's place.
events: Lin Dong meets Jiang Lei, his daughters Jiang Xue and Jiang Yinyin, and the Eagle Martial Dojo disciples.
Jiang Lei tells him the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet holds an ancient sect's ruins and opens every three years; Little Mink thinks it may hold an Ancestral Symbol.
The Mist Leopard Alligator King attacks; Lin Dong drives off two Form Creation beasts and saves the dojo.
They leave the Mist Forest and reach Eagle City, at the edge of a desert with the tablet at its centre.
Luo Shan delivers Luo Jiu's challenge to a fight to the death, pesters Jiang Xue, and Lin Dong thrashes him.
Jiang Xue asks Lin Dong to fight Luo Jiu for her father.
cultivation: Jiang Lei is Form Creation advanced; Luo Jiu reached Form Creation peak half a month ago, about as strong as Wang Yan. The two beasts Lin Dong fights are Form Creation. Even Nirvana experts cannot easily break the ancient tablet's seal.

title: Fight to the Death
summary: Lin Dong agrees to help the Jiang family and enters the fight to the death as a new Eagle Martial Dojo disciple, facing Luo Jiu, who is Form Creation peak. Luo Jiu attacks with Mental Strength, a low-grade Soul Treasure hammer and the Demon Ape Transformation, but Lin Dong beats him with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and the Heavenly Dragon Halberd. Luo Jiu gives up, and the Bloody Vulture Dojo is ordered out of Eagle City. Lin Dong slips away without saying goodbye, but Jiang Xue catches up with him on the road to see him off. Among Luo Jiu's things he finds a bone slip with the Demon Ape Transformation, which Little Mink says is far stronger with pure demon ape blood. In the Ancient Wasteland, two Ancient Sword Sect disciples try to rob him. Then an Ancient Dragon Ape appears, and its blood is just what the Demon Ape Transformation needs.
events: Jiang Xue asks Lin Dong to help, and he agrees because the Jiangs treated him as a friend.
At the arena, Lin Dong fights in Jiang Lei's place against Luo Jiu, who is Form Creation peak.
Luo Jiu uses Mental Strength, a low-grade Soul Treasure hammer and the Demon Ape Transformation, but Lin Dong wins with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and the Heavenly Dragon Halberd.
Luo Jiu gives up, and the Bloody Vulture Dojo is driven out of Eagle City.
Lin Dong leaves quietly; Jiang Xue catches up with him on the road to say goodbye.
He finds Luo Jiu's Pure Yuan Pills and the bone slip for the Demon Ape Transformation.
In the Ancient Wasteland, Ancient Sword Sect disciples demand a toll, and an Ancient Dragon Ape appears.
cultivation: Luo Jiu is Form Creation peak and also trains Mental Strength. His Demon Ape Transformation uses ordinary demon ape blood; Little Mink says Ancient Dragon Ape blood would make it far stronger.

title: The Myriad Beast Fruit
summary: Lin Dong and Little Mink sneak into the Ancient Dragon Ape's lair, only to find it is already at Manifestation. They cannot get its blood, but they find the Myriad Beast Fruits it is growing from the blood of countless beasts. Little Mink hides the ape's brand on the fruits, and Lin Dong takes two. Ancient Sword Sect elder Gu Yan, a Qi Creation expert, corners Lin Dong and takes one fruit as payment, not knowing it still carries the ape's brand. The ape tracks the fruit to the sect's camp. The sect leader and his disciples hold it off with the Great Ancient Sword Formation. While the injured ape rests, Little Mink hypnotises it, and Lin Dong draws its blood essence before it wakes.
events: Little Mink realises too late that the Ancient Dragon Ape has reached Manifestation.
In its lair they find the Myriad Beast Fruits, made from the blood of countless beasts.
Little Mink hides the ape's brand, and Lin Dong takes two fruits.
Gu Yan of the Ancient Sword Sect, a Qi Creation expert, demands payment, and Lin Dong hands over a branded fruit as a 'blood fruit'.
Lin Dong follows Gu Yan to the sect camp, where Gu Yan shows the fruit to the sect leader.
The ape tracks its brand to the camp, and the sect holds it off with the Great Ancient Sword Formation.
Little Mink hypnotises the wounded ape and Lin Dong draws its blood essence, but the ape starts to wake.
cultivation: The Ancient Dragon Ape is Manifestation; with the Myriad Beast Fruit it could rival Nirvana. Gu Yan is Qi Creation. Gu Yan hopes the fruit will raise him to Qi Creation advanced, the sect leader's realm.

title: Great Puppet City
summary: Little Flame helps Lin Dong escape the waking Ancient Dragon Ape into a cave, where he refines the ape's violent blood essence and masters the Demon Ape Transformation. When Gu Yan finds him that night, Lin Dong combines it with the Copper Thunder Body and his halberd and gets away. Little Mink explains that the halberd's true dragon blood is waking, so it can be raised to a high-grade Soul Treasure. At the Martial Alliance auction in Great Puppet City, Lin Dong buys the Magic Scales Gold Heart. On Little Mink's advice he also outbids Hua Zong of the Yin Puppet Sect, paying 100,000 Pure Yuan Pills for a strange prayer mat. He meets Mu Qianqian of the Great Demon Sect, and Grand Master Cheng upgrades his halberd at the Thousand Treasure Tower. Hua Zong then demands to buy the halberd and gives Lin Dong one day to think it over.
events: Little Flame transforms and carries Lin Dong past the Ancient Dragon Ape into a cave.
Lin Dong refines the Dragon Ape blood essence, fights off its violent will and masters the Demon Ape Transformation.
He beats back Gu Yan with the Demon Ape Transformation, the Copper Thunder Body and the Heavenly Dragon Halberd, then escapes.
The Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd's true dragon blood begins to show, and it needs materials and a Symbol Master to be upgraded.
At the Martial Alliance auction in Great Puppet City, Lin Dong buys the Magic Scales Gold Heart for 20,000 and a mysterious prayer mat for 100,000.
He meets Mu Qianqian of the Great Demon Sect and her rival bidder Hua Zong of the Yin Puppet Sect.
Grand Master Cheng refines the halberd into a high-grade Soul Treasure, and Hua Zong gives Lin Dong one day to sell it to him.
cultivation: Lin Dong masters the Demon Ape Transformation with Ancient Dragon Ape blood and can combine it with the Copper Thunder Body. Gu Yan is Qi Creation. Mu Qianqian is at least Qi Creation initial. The Ancient Heavenly Scales Halberd becomes a high-grade Soul Treasure.

title: Yuan Essence Power
summary: Hua Zong's father gives him a Symbol Puppet for the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet, and Hua Zong has his men watch Lin Dong's inn. Lin Dong wakes the prayer mat by pouring in Yuan Power and Mental Strength together, and its rare formation fuses them into Yuan Essence Power. Leaving Great Puppet City, he is ambushed by Hua Zong and two Form Creation peak followers who want his halberd, and Little Flame leads the followers away. Hua Zong is a Spirit Symbol Master, and his puppet and Mysterious Earth Armor shrug off Lin Dong's attacks until Yuan Essence Power breaks the armor. When Hua Zong tries to drain Lin Dong's Mental Strength, the technique backfires and kills him. Hua Zong's father swears to cut Lin Dong to pieces.
events: Hua Zong's father gives him a Symbol Puppet fused with his own Mental Strength.
Lin Dong opens the prayer mat by feeding it Yuan Power and Mental Strength in balance and gains Yuan Essence Power.
Leaving Great Puppet City, he is ambushed by Hua Zong and two Form Creation peak men.
Little Flame carries Lin Dong's scent away and draws the followers off.
Hua Zong fights with his Symbol Puppet, many Soul Treasures and the Mysterious Earth Armor.
Lin Dong smashes the armor with Yuan Essence Power; Hua Zong's draining technique backfires and he dies.
Lin Dong is left with two clashing Mental Strengths inside him, and Hua Zong's father vows revenge.
cultivation: Lin Dong gains Yuan Essence Power, a fusion of Yuan Power and Mental Strength, from the prayer mat's formation. Hua Zong's two followers are Form Creation peak. Lin Dong takes in Hua Zong's gloomy Mental Strength and must refine it.

title: Hua Gu's Revenge
summary: Mu Qianqian learns that Lin Dong killed Hua Zong, and that his father, Elder Hua Gu, has sent the whole Yin Puppet Sect branch after him. Lin Dong absorbs Hua Zong's Mental Strength in a hiding place, then starts refining the Myriad Beast Fruit to grow stronger fast. Hua Gu, a Qi Creation advanced expert, finds the hideout, and Little Mink, in his demon spirit form, and Little Flame hold him off until they are badly hurt. Lin Dong comes out and fights Hua Gu with the Demon Ape Transformation, his halberd and Yuan Essence Power, and the injured Hua Gu flees. Lin Dong collapses and wakes inside the Great Demon Sect, where Mu Qianqian has taken him in. She invites him to join and warns him that the Yin Puppet Sect and the Four Great Clans will be at the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet. He refuses her offer and insists he must go.
events: Mu Qianqian's maid reports that Hua Gu has sent every man of his Yin Puppet Sect branch after Lin Dong.
Lin Dong absorbs Hua Zong's Mental Strength, then begins refining the Myriad Beast Fruit while Little Mink and Little Flame stand guard.
Hua Gu finds them; Little Mink appears as a demon spirit, and he and Little Flame hold Hua Gu off at great cost.
Lin Dong emerges and fights Hua Gu with the Demon Ape Transformation, the Heavenly Dragon Halberd and Yuan Essence Power.
The wounded Hua Gu runs, and Lin Dong passes out.
He wakes in the Great Demon Sect, rescued by Mu Qianqian, and turns down her offer to join.
She warns him the Yin Puppet Sect and the Four Great Clans will be at the tablet; he still means to go.
cultivation: Hua Gu is Qi Creation advanced. Little Mink says refining the Myriad Beast Fruit should lift Lin Dong to at least Form Creation peak and push his Copper Thunder Body further. Little Mink cannot beat a Qi Creation fighter in his present state.

title: The Four Great Clans
summary: Crowds gather at the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet, where Mu Qianqian tells Teng Lei, young master of the Yin Puppet Sect, that Lin Dong has left. Teng Lei senses Hua Zong's Mental Strength on Lin Dong and attacks him anyway. Then the Four Great Clans arrive: Lin Langtian of the Lin Clan with Lin Ke-er, the Qin Clan, Huangpu Jing of the Huangpu Clan and Wang Yan of the Wang Clan. Lin Langtian calls Lin Dong a branch-family nobody and lets Wang Yan, now Qi Creation initial, deal with him. Lin Dong beats Wang Yan with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm, a Wang family art he uses better than Wang Yan does. When Wang Yan's elder, Wang Tong, steps in, Lin Dong shames Lin Langtian in front of everyone for bowing to the Wang Clan, and Elder Lin Mu stops Lin Langtian from seizing him. The tablet opens and everyone heads inside.
events: At the tablet, Mu Qianqian fends off Teng Lei, young master of the Yin Puppet Sect, and claims Lin Dong has left.
Teng Lei senses Hua Zong's Mental Strength on Lin Dong and attacks him, meaning to turn him into a Symbol Puppet.
The Four Great Clans arrive: Lin Langtian, Lin Ke-er, the Qin Clan, Huangpu Jing and Wang Yan.
Lin Langtian disowns Lin Dong as branch-family trash and lets Wang Yan settle his score.
Lin Dong beats Wang Yan with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and the Great Sun Thunder Body.
Wang Tong steps in; Lin Dong calls Lin Langtian a traitor to his clan, and Elder Lin Mu stops Lin Langtian from seizing him.
The ancient tablet opens and the Four Great Clans lead the crowd inside.
cultivation: Wang Yan is Qi Creation initial and Wang Tong is Qi Creation advanced. Little Mink says Lin Langtian is much stronger than a year ago and still beyond Lin Dong. The Lin Clan Gathering is one year away.

title: Jade Thunder Body
summary: Inside the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet, Lin Dong finds a vast space left by an ancient sect, abandoned for thousands of years. An underground beast drags him into quicksand tunnels and splits him from Little Flame. To escape, he and Little Mink jump through a Yin Wind Formation whose winds nearly tear him apart but push his Great Sun Thunder Body up to the Jade Thunder Body. Past the barrier lies an ancient disciple's body, and Lin Dong sees flashes of his memories: disciples fighting a terrible force, and an old man holding a black rune, which Little Mink says is the Ancestral Symbol. The body also leaves him a Nirvana Pill. Gu Yan of the Ancient Sword Sect has caught Little Flame. Lin Dong takes a full blow from him to save it, punches him over the edge of a chasm and leaves him hanging there.
events: The tablet opens into a huge space made by the ancient sect, thick with Yuan Power.
An underground beast attacks; Lin Dong falls through quicksand into tunnels and loses Little Flame.
He and Little Mink leap through a Yin Wind Formation, and he forms the Jade Thunder Body.
They find an ancient disciple's body; Lin Dong sees his memories of a battle and of an old man with a black rune.
Little Mink says the black rune is the Ancestral Symbol and that it is inside the tablet space; Lin Dong gets a Nirvana Pill.
Gu Yan has captured Little Flame; Lin Dong takes his blow, frees Little Flame and punches Gu Yan over a chasm's edge, leaving him there.
cultivation: Lin Dong's Great Sun Thunder Body advances from the Copper Thunder Body to the Jade Thunder Body. The Nirvana Pill is made only by Nirvana experts and will help him when he nears Nirvana.

title: The Previous Master
summary: Lin Dong's Destiny Symbol leads him to a hall where Elder Cao of the Yin Puppet Sect is binding a high-grade Symbol Puppet, and Lin Dong forces Cao to give it up. Teng Lei arrives and fights Mu Qianqian, thinking she has it. Lin Dong drags Cao down through the Nine Underworld Cold Qi, but the altar below is empty, because the Yin Puppet Sect's master took the treasure three years ago. Inside a black stone pillar, Lin Dong meets the previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol. The old man tests him with his memories, approves of him, and gives him the means to break the Ancestral Symbol's seal, warning that its power comes with a duty. Back outside, Lin Dong turns the high-grade Symbol Puppet on Teng Lei and his Yin Puppet Formation and drives them off. Mu Qianqian then tells him about the Manifestation Martial Tablet.
events: Lin Dong catches Elder Cao binding a high-grade Symbol Puppet and forces him to give it up.
Teng Lei accuses Mu Qianqian of taking the puppet, and their groups fight.
Lin Dong takes Cao down through the Nine Underworld Cold Qi to an empty altar; Cao says the Yin Puppet Sect's master took the treasure three years ago.
Through a black stone pillar Lin Dong meets the previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol, who recognises Little Mink as a Celestial Demon Marten.
The old man tests Lin Dong with his memories, approves of him, and gives him what he needs to break the Ancestral Symbol's seal.
Lin Dong leaves Cao behind as promised, then crushes Teng Lei's Yin Puppet Formation with the high-grade Symbol Puppet, which burns through his Pure Yuan Pills.
Mu Qianqian tells him about the Manifestation Martial Tablet, where Manifestation-grade martial arts can be won.
cultivation: Only Manifestation experts can normally pass the Nine Underworld Cold Qi. The previous master of the Devouring Ancestral Symbol approves Lin Dong. The high-grade Symbol Puppet runs on Pure Yuan Pills and drains them fast.

title: The Manifestation Martial Tablet
summary: Before the Manifestation Martial Tablet, the strongest fighters compete for its ten seats. Lin Langtian, now Half-step Manifestation, takes one at once, and Wang Yan sits only because the Wang Clan backs him. When Lin Dong steps up, Wang Tong attacks him, but Lin Dong wins his seat with the Demon Ape Transformation, the Heavenly Dragon Halberd, his high-grade Symbol Puppet and the Jade Thunder Body. The tablet carries the seated fighters into a space full of the ancient sect's martial arts. Lin Dong and Little Mink chase the tablet's soul, which shows them memories of the creatures that destroyed the ancient sect. The black-eyed elder appears and calls Lin Dong his heir. The elder's young disciple leads Lin Dong to a store of Manifestation-grade martial arts, but she tells him he must learn one strange art in particular.
events: Fighters gather before the Manifestation Martial Tablet to compete for its ten seats.
Lin Langtian, Half-step Manifestation, takes a seat; Wang Yan takes one with the Wang Clan's backing.
Lin Dong claims a seat, and Wang Tong attacks him for it.
Lin Dong beats Wang Tong with the Demon Ape Transformation, the Heavenly Dragon Halberd, the high-grade Symbol Puppet and the Jade Thunder Body.
The tablet starts, and the seated fighters enter its martial arts space; Lin Dong finds only lesser arts, such as a 6th-grade palm.
Lin Dong and Little Mink catch the tablet's soul and flee from memories of the beings that destroyed the ancient sect.
The black-eyed elder names Lin Dong his heir, and his disciple leads Lin Dong to the Manifestation martial arts.
cultivation: Lin Langtian is Half-step Manifestation. Little Mink says a Manifestation-grade martial art from the tablet would let Lin Dong stand against him. Wang Tong is Qi Creation advanced (EP33).

title: Two Creation Martial Arts
summary: Lin Dong breaks through to Qi Creation inside the Manifestation Martial Tablet and then receives the ancient sect's Manifestation martial art. Most of the young fighters come out with nothing, but Lin Langtian also wins a Manifestation martial art. Lin Ke-er introduces Lin Dong to Elder Lin Mu of the Lin Clan, who praises him and hopes he does well at the clan competition. Lin Langtian then reveals that an ancient sect's underground palace lies under the monument, with treasure and a powerful guardian beast. The Four Great Clans, the Great Demon Sect, the Yin Puppet Sect and many others go in together. The four clans wound the guardian, an Ancient Blood Bat Dragon, with their Four Symbols formation, and it flees. Lin Dong, Little Mink and Little Flame track it down and finish it off with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm and Lin Dong's Symbol Puppet, so Little Mink can take its demon spirit.
events: Lin Dong breaks through to Qi Creation in the monument space, to the surprise of the watching crowd.
He accepts the ancient sect's inheritance and comes out with a Manifestation martial art; Lin Langtian also gets one.
Lin Ke-er introduces Lin Dong to Elder Lin Mu, who praises him ahead of the Lin Clan Gathering.
Lin Langtian announces the underground palace of the ancient sect and its guardian beast, and invites everyone to join.
The crowd breaks the formation and rushes in; the Four Great Clans wound the guardian with the Four Symbols formation.
Little Mink names the guardian an Ancient Blood Bat Dragon with true dragon blood and wants its demon spirit.
Lin Dong, Little Mink and Little Flame ambush the wounded dragon and bring it down; Little Mink and Little Flame squabble over it.
introduced: underground palace of the ancient sect
cultivation: Lin Dong breaks through to Qi Creation inside the Manifestation Martial Tablet. Both he and Lin Langtian obtain Manifestation martial arts.

title: The Guardian of the Ancient Sect
summary: A terrifying guardian rises in the underground palace, at least a Five Yuan Nirvana expert, and everyone flees. The Four Great Clans force the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet's exit open early with their combined Yuan Power. At the collapsing exit Lin Langtian leaves Lin Dong behind, and it turns out the guardian is chasing Lin Langtian's stolen Qiankun Bag, which has landed with Lin Dong. Lin Dong finds it is full of Nirvana Pills. Trapped, he fights the guardian with the Demon Ape Transformation, his halberd, his Symbol Puppet, Little Mink and Little Flame. Finally he uses the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, which leaves his body unable to move; the guardian, Tian Ze, recognises his sect's secret art, and the Black-Eyed Elder appears and tells him Lin Dong is his heir. Tian Ze restores Lin Dong's Yuan Power and lets him go, and Lin Dong leaves the tablet to raise his cultivation and look for the Ancestral Symbol.
events: The guardian appears; Lin Mu and the Four Great Clans lead a retreat to the tablet's exit.
The four clans pour their Yuan Power into the tablet and force the exit open before its time.
Lin Dong saves Mu Qianqian at the collapsing exit; Lin Langtian tells him to stay and die.
The guardian was chasing Lin Langtian's Qiankun Bag from the palace; Lin Dong now holds it, and it is full of Nirvana Pills.
The other factions blame Lin Langtian for their losses and leave; Lin Dong is left facing the guardian.
Lin Dong uses everything he has, ending with the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, and is left paralysed.
Tian Ze recognises the secret art; the Black-Eyed Elder says he passed the Ancestral Symbol's will to Lin Dong, and Tian Ze spares him.
Lin Dong wakes Little Mink, leaves the tablet and sets his goals: grow stronger, then find the Ancestral Symbol.
cultivation: The guardian Tian Ze is at least a Five Yuan Nirvana expert. Lin Dong's body cannot yet bear the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.

title: Trouble at the Yin Puppet Sect's Door
summary: Teng Sha, master of the Yin Puppet Sect, leaves seclusion at Manifestation peak and orders his elders home to break the seal on a treasure the sect took from the ancient tablet. Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire, Little Mink takes in the Blood Bat Dragon's demon spirit, and Little Flame condenses a demon spirit of its own. The Ancestral Symbol was taken by the Yin Puppet Sect's master, so Lin Dong goes to the sect in Great Puppet City and calls Teng Lei out. He beats Elder Hua Gu, then holds off Teng Lei's 9th-grade Purple Shadow Nine Breaks and the sect's Yin Puppet Demon Gathering Formation with the Demon Ape Transformation and the new Jade Thunder Body. The fight is a diversion. Little Mink and Little Flame search the sect through a secret passage, but find no word of the Ancestral Symbol. Mu Qianqian and her father Mu Lei come to watch; as they leave, Cao Zhen, a Half-step Manifestation elder, comes out of seclusion.
events: Teng Sha leaves seclusion at Manifestation peak and calls his elders back to break the treasure's seal.
Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire; Little Mink glimpses his old human form, and Little Flame condenses a demon spirit.
Lin Dong turns up at the Yin Puppet Sect's gate in Great Puppet City and calls out Teng Lei.
He beats Hua Gu, who wants revenge for his son Hua Zong.
Teng Lei fights with the 9th-grade Purple Shadow Nine Breaks; Lin Dong answers with the Demon Ape Transformation and the Jade Thunder Body.
Teng Lei has his disciples start the Yin Puppet Demon Gathering Formation, and Lin Dong breaks it with his halberd.
Little Mink and Little Flame search a secret passage but find nothing about the Ancestral Symbol.
Mu Qianqian and Mu Lei of the Great Demon Sect watch; Cao Zhen appears at Half-step Manifestation.
cultivation: Teng Sha has reached Manifestation peak. Cao Zhen is Half-step Manifestation. Lin Dong forms Mental Energy Fire and shows the Jade Thunder Body. Little Flame condenses a demon spirit.

title: Blood Slayer Cao Zhen
summary: Cao Zhen kills the beaten Elder Hua Gu and takes his Mental Strength, then turns on Lin Dong. Mu Lei explains to Mu Qianqian that Cao Zhen, the Blood Slayer, once wiped out a whole sect by himself. Lin Dong fights the Half-step Manifestation elder with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm, the Demon Ape Transformation and Yuan Essence Power. He is nearly crushed until he shows Mental Energy Fire and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger; Cao Zhen survives, but Little Flame grabs Teng Lei and they escape. Under threat of a memory search, Teng Lei reveals that his father will break the treasure's seal in Yin Puppet City in ten days, and that the sect has three Manifestation experts. Lin Dong also takes Teng Lei's Purple Shadow Nine Breaks. Teng Sha keeps his son's capture quiet, while Mu Lei gathers his Qi Creation experts and heads for Yin Puppet City.
events: Cao Zhen kills Hua Gu and takes his Mental Strength.
Mu Lei tells Mu Qianqian about Cao Zhen, the Blood Slayer.
Lin Dong fights Cao Zhen with the Golden Platform palm, the Demon Ape Transformation and Yuan Essence Power, but falls behind.
He turns the fight with Mental Energy Fire and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Lin Dong and Little Flame carry Teng Lei off while the wounded Cao Zhen watches.
Teng Lei tells him the treasure is in Yin Puppet City, the seal will be broken in ten days, and the sect has three Manifestation experts; Lin Dong takes the Purple Shadow Nine Breaks.
Teng Sha orders silence and more guards; Mu Lei suspects something big and sets out for Yin Puppet City.
cultivation: Cao Zhen is Half-step Manifestation; Lin Dong is Qi Creation. The Yin Puppet Sect has three Manifestation experts, including Teng Sha.

title: Breaking the Ancestral Symbol's Seal
summary: Teng Lei leads Lin Dong to Yin Puppet City by a back path over Yin Puppet Mountain, hoping its Yin Sha energy will kill him, but Little Mink gets them through. At the sign of opposition Teng Sha and his elders set up the Nine Yin Devil Formation to break the treasure's seal, and Lin Dong's Destiny Spirit Symbol tells him it is the Ancestral Symbol. Nearby, Ling Qingzhu and Old Ma Yi of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace pass Sky Flame Mountain on another mission. The seal opens, but a remnant of the Black-Eyed Elder appears and drains the sect's experts with the Death Force. Mu Lei of the Great Demon Sect and Wu Zong of the Martial Alliance then attack to take the treasure. Teng Sha shows two high-grade Symbol Puppets and reveals that he has reached Manifestation peak, beating both men. In the end the three sects agree that nine Manifestation experts will break the seal together, and at that moment Lin Dong bursts in.
events: Teng Lei sends Lin Dong over the Yin Sha-filled Yin Puppet Mountain; Little Mink handles the energy.
Teng Sha's sect raises the Nine Yin Devil Formation at the sign of opposition; Lin Dong's Destiny Spirit Symbol senses the Ancestral Symbol.
Ling Qingzhu and Old Ma Yi pass by; she senses strange Yuan Power but keeps to her master's task.
The seal breaks open, but the Black-Eyed Elder's afterimage appears and drains the elders with the Death Force.
Mu Lei and Wu Zong arrive; a three-sect fight breaks out and the Yin Puppet Sect brings out two high-grade Symbol Puppets.
Teng Sha reveals he is at Manifestation peak and beats Mu Lei and Wu Zong.
The three sects agree to break the seal together with nine Manifestation experts; Lin Dong charges in.
cultivation: Teng Sha says he recently broke through to Manifestation peak. The Great Demon Sect and Martial Alliance elders are all at least Manifestation; nine Manifestation experts gather to break the seal.

title: Into the Xuanyin Crack
summary: Lin Dong breaks the treasure's seal himself and runs off with the Ancestral Symbol, knocking Cao Zhen back with one punch. Mu Lei and Wu Zong stay out of it, and the whole Yin Puppet Sect gives chase. Lin Dong fights its high-grade Symbol Puppets with his own Symbol Puppet and the Demon Ape Transformation, then takes Teng Lei as a hostage to make Teng Sha back off. Teng Sha strikes anyway, through his own son, leaving Teng Lei half dead and Lin Dong badly hurt; Little Flame carries Lin Dong to the Xuanyin Crack, but Teng Sha keeps up with them. There Lin Dong's Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger meets Teng Sha's Manifestation martial art and loses. With no way out, Lin Dong leads Teng Sha on and leaps into the deadly cold depths of the crack. Teng Sha orders his whole sect to guard the crack until Lin Dong is found, alive or dead.
events: The seal breaks and Lin Dong seizes the Ancestral Symbol, punching Cao Zhen back.
Teng Sha warns Mu Lei and Wu Zong off; they hope Lin Dong escapes.
Lin Dong fights the pursuers with his Symbol Puppet and the Demon Ape Transformation.
He holds Teng Lei hostage; Teng Sha promises safe passage, then strikes through his son.
Little Flame carries the wounded Lin Dong to the Xuanyin Crack with Teng Sha close behind.
Teng Sha's Manifestation martial art beats the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Lin Dong and his companions jump into the depths; the Yin Puppet Sect stations disciples around the crack.
cultivation: Teng Sha is Manifestation peak; Lin Dong is still Qi Creation and can use only a fraction of his Manifestation martial art.

title: The Devouring Ancestral Symbol's Test
summary: Lin Dong wakes deep in the Xuanyin Crack, where the Stone Talisman shielded him from the Earth Sha cold. Little Mink spends 200,000 Pure Yuan Pills on a formation that cleans the cold out of the Yuan Power, and Lin Dong heals in four hours. He then opens the seal and sends his mind into the Devouring Ancestral Symbol, guided by the Black-Eyed Elder's voice. The Symbol's spirit shuts him in endless darkness and then tempts him with a dream of a peaceful home with Qing Tan, his father and grandfather. Lin Dong chooses to go on, merges with the Power of Devouring and becomes the Symbol's heir; he is told the world will be his responsibility when a destined calamity comes. Six months pass outside, with Little Mink guarding his body and fending off an Eight Eye Earth Devil Spider; Lin Dong comes out with Mental Strength at least at advanced Spirit Symbol Master. Meanwhile the Yin Puppet Sect sets an ambush for Little Flame, which has spent the six months killing its men.
events: Lin Dong wakes in the Xuanyin Crack; the Stone Talisman protected him.
Little Mink spends 200,000 Pure Yuan Pills on an essence-refining formation and Lin Dong heals.
Lin Dong opens the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and enters it with his mind.
The Symbol's spirit traps him in darkness, then shows him a dream of home with Qing Tan, Lin Xiao and Lin Zhentian.
He leaves the dream, merges with the Power of Devouring and is accepted as the Symbol's heir.
Little Mink guards his body for six months and lures off an Eight Eye Earth Devil Spider.
Lin Dong wakes with Mental Strength of at least an advanced Spirit Symbol Master.
The Yin Puppet Sect lays an ambush for Little Flame.
cultivation: Lin Dong refines the Devouring Ancestral Symbol. Little Mink says his Mental Strength is now at least that of an advanced Spirit Symbol Master.

title: The Fall of the Yin Puppet Sect
summary: Using the Devouring Ancestral Symbol to turn the crack's cold into Yuan Power, Lin Dong jumps from Qi Creation to Half-step Manifestation. Little Mink warns him not to push his Yuan Dan further; he learns that Teng Sha has captured Little Flame and means to turn it into a beast puppet. Teng Sha is hosting the sects of the Great Desolate Province to form an alliance when Lin Dong bursts in; he kills Cao Zhen in one move, and the other sects refuse to get involved. Lin Dong presses Teng Sha with his halberd, the Purple Shadow Nine Breaks, the Great Desolate Sea-Splitting Seal and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. Then he breaks Teng Sha's last move and the sect's protective formation with the Power of Devouring and kills him, seeing some of his memories. Not far away, Ling Qingzhu finds a sabotaged formation for the Hundred Dynasties Battle, and Old Ma Yi stays behind. Mu Lei thanks Lin Dong with Pure Yuan Pills and a robe, and Mu Qianqian agrees to look after the Eagle Martial Dojo.
events: Lin Dong reaches Half-step Manifestation in the Xuanyin Crack with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol.
He learns Little Flame was captured and taken to the Yin Puppet Sect.
Teng Sha proposes an alliance of the Great Desolate Province sects; Mu Lei and Wu Zong hold back.
Lin Dong arrives, frees Little Flame, kills Cao Zhen in one move and tells the other sects to stay out.
He beats Teng Sha at Manifestation peak with his halberd, the Great Desolate techniques and the Power of Devouring.
He devours the Yin Puppet Sect's protective formation, kills Teng Sha and sees some of his memories.
Ling Qingzhu inspects Hundred Dynasties Battle formations around the Ancient Battlefield; Old Ma Yi stays to watch one.
Mu Lei rewards Lin Dong; Lin Dong asks Mu Qianqian to protect the Eagle Martial Dojo and leaves for the Lin Clan Gathering.
cultivation: Lin Dong breaks through from Qi Creation to Half-step Manifestation. Teng Sha is Manifestation peak. Cao Zhen was Half-step Manifestation.

title: The Blood Spirit Puppet
summary: In Yan City, Lin Xia beats Lin Hong in a family trial, and Lin Xiao tells Lin Zhentian the young ones are ready for the Lin Clan Gathering. Qing Tan has trained in the mountains for a year with a mysterious senior and reached Qi Creation; she chooses to stay with her family, and the senior gives her a sect token to call on later. From Teng Sha's memories, Lin Dong goes to Yin Puppet Mountain and finds a sealed Blood Spirit Puppet, as strong as a Nirvana expert but hungry for blood. Little Mink and Little Flame hold it off while Lin Dong struggles to work the Stone Talisman. In the end he uses the Power of Devouring on the cold energy, seals the puppet inside the Stone Talisman and makes a contract with it. He heads home for the clan competition in three months, aiming to perfect the Great Sun Thunder Body on the way. Meanwhile a strong old man questions the Yin Puppet Sect's survivors and sets out after Lin Dong.
events: Lin Xia beats Lin Hong in a Yan City family trial before the clan competition.
Qing Tan returns at Qi Creation after a year with a senior, declines to leave her family and receives a sect token.
Lin Dong finds the Blood Spirit Puppet sealed deep in Yin Puppet Mountain.
Little Mink explains spirit puppets and suggests sealing it in the Stone Talisman.
The puppet breaks loose; Little Mink and Little Flame stall it while Lin Dong uses the Great Desolate Sea-Splitting Seal and the Stone Talisman.
With the Power of Devouring he seals the puppet in the Stone Talisman and makes a contract with it.
Lin Dong sets off for the clan competition; an old man hunts the Yin Puppet Sect's survivors for news of him.
cultivation: Qing Tan has reached Qi Creation. Lin Xia and Lin Hong are at the peak of Yuan Dan. A Blood Spirit Puppet matches a Nirvana expert. Little Mink guesses Lin Langtian has reached Manifestation peak.

title: Old Ma Yi's Pursuit
