summary: In Lin City, Elder Lin Mu recommends Lin Dong to patriarch Lin Fan, and other elders mock the branch family. Lin Langtian is put in charge of the Lin Clan Gathering, and alone he hears a voice inside him order him to kill Lin Dong and bring it the thing Lin Dong carries. Elder Lin Zheng plans to make trouble for the Yan City branch. Lin Dong perfects the Great Sun Thunder Body, but Old Ma Yi, a Nirvana expert, catches him while hunting for the Devouring Ancestral Symbol. Lin Dong fights back with the Blood Spirit Puppet and the Power of Devouring; then he hands over an Ancestral Symbol rubbing instead of the real Symbol. Ma Yi swaps it for a Manifestation-level martial art, which turns out to be incomplete; Ling Qingzhu then arrives and kills Ma Yi for disobeying orders, even after he burns his own blood essence. Lin Dong hides and does not show himself, and he leaves for Lin City as the clan competition begins.
events: Elder Lin Mu speaks up for Lin Dong; Lin Fan gives Lin Langtian charge of the clan competition.
A voice inside Lin Langtian orders him to kill Lin Dong and bring back what he carries.
Elder Lin Zheng promises Lin Langtian to make things hard for the Yan City branch.
After two months Lin Dong perfects the Great Sun Thunder Body.
Old Ma Yi, a Nirvana expert, attacks to search Lin Dong for the Devouring Ancestral Symbol; Lin Dong uses the Blood Spirit Puppet and the Power of Devouring.
Lin Dong tricks him with an Ancestral Symbol rubbing and gets an incomplete Manifestation-level martial art in exchange.
Ling Qingzhu kills Ma Yi for acting without orders; Lin Dong watches from hiding.
Lin Dong heads to Lin City, and the clan competition opens.
cultivation: Lin Dong perfects the Great Sun Thunder Body and is Half-step Manifestation. Old Ma Yi is a Nirvana expert.

title: The Lin Clan Gathering
summary: At the Lin Clan Gathering the Yan City branch is drawn against strong clan disciples, a set-up by Elder Lin Zheng. Lin Feng and a clan fighter called Lin Mang badly beat Lin Hong and Lin Xia. Qing Tan surprises everyone by beating Lin Chen, and Lin Feng, a Qi Creation fighter, challenges her. She seals his Yuan Dan, so he secretly takes a pill and attacks with the Roaring Fire Palm. Lin Dong arrives and stops him, exposes the pill, and Lin Feng is taken away; Lin Dong then challenges Lin Langtian. Lin Zheng first makes him face the twins Lin Qing and Lin Mu, both at the top of Half-step Manifestation. Lin Dong takes them on together and beats both with a single move; Lin Langtian finally steps into the arena.
events: The Yan City branch is drawn against top clan disciples; Lin Hong and Lin Xia are beaten badly.
Lin Xiao and Lin Zhentian see the draw was rigged.
Qing Tan beats Lin Chen; Lin Feng challenges her, and she seals his Yuan Dan.
Lin Feng takes a pill and attacks with the Roaring Fire Palm; Lin Dong steps in and stops him.
Lin Dong exposes the pill; Lin Mu has Lin Feng arrested and Qing Tan is declared the winner.
Lin Dong challenges Lin Langtian; Lin Zheng makes him face the twins Lin Qing and Lin Mu first.
Lin Dong beats both twins with one move, and Lin Langtian comes down to fight.
cultivation: Lin Feng is Qi Creation. The twins Lin Qing and Lin Mu are at the top of Half-step Manifestation. Onlookers judge Lin Dong to be at least Half-step Manifestation.

title: Champion of the Lin Clan
summary: Lin Dong and Lin Langtian fight at full strength; Lin Langtian is at Manifestation, though not yet at its peak. Lin Dong matches his Great Heavenly Phoenix Seal and Hand of the Universal Emperor with the Great Sun Thunder Body, his Mental Strength and the Great Desolate techniques. When Lin Langtian draws power from the thing inside him, Lin Dong answers with the Power of Devouring, until patriarch Lin Fan, a Nirvana expert, stops the fight before Lin City is wrecked. Lin Fan names Lin Dong champion, and the Yan City branch returns to the clan. In private Lin Fan tells him about the Hundred Dynasties Battle and the super sects, and asks him to compete for the Great Yan Dynasty's places next month alongside Lin Langtian. In the clan's treasure vault Lin Zheng's ally Lin Zhi turns the formations on him. Lin Dong has the Blood Spirit Puppet smash the formation eye, binds the Earth-grade Heavy Prison Peak and reaches Manifestation initial; after an argument with Qing Tan, he sails for the Imperial City.
events: Lin Dong fights Lin Langtian; Lin Langtian is Manifestation but not at its peak.
They trade Manifestation martial arts; Lin Dong's Mental Strength presses Lin Langtian back.
Lin Langtian draws power from the thing inside him; Lin Dong uses the Power of Devouring; Lin Fan stops the fight.
Lin Fan names Lin Dong champion and tells him about the Hundred Dynasties Battle and the super sects.
In the treasure vault, Lin Zhi and Lin Zheng turn the formations on Lin Dong; the Blood Spirit Puppet destroys the formation eye.
Lin Dong binds the Heavy Prison Peak with his blood essence and the Stone Talisman, and reaches Manifestation initial in a month.
Qing Tan begs to come along and is hurt when he refuses; Lin Dong and Lin Langtian set off for the Imperial City.
cultivation: Lin Langtian is Manifestation, not yet peak. Lin Fan is Nirvana. Lin Dong's Mental Strength matches an advanced Spirit Symbol Master, and after a month in the treasure vault he reaches Manifestation initial.

title: The Battle of Seeds
summary: Lin Dong arrives at the Imperial City of the Great Yan Dynasty with Lin Fan and the Lin Clan team for the Battle of Seeds, which offers only five places in the Hundred Dynasties Battle. Wang Zhong, Wang Yan's elder brother and the Wang Clan's genius, threatens Lin Dong, and the draw puts them in the same group. Lin Dong first beats Huangpu Ying. Wang Zhong then attacks with the Blood Demonic Asura Spear, which drains Yuan Power, but Lin Dong answers with the Heavy Prison Peak and finishes him with four fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. Mo Ling, Lin Langtian, Du Yun, Man Shan and Lin Dong win the five places. Emperor Mo Jingtian rewards them with training in the Sacred Spirit Pool.
events: Lin Dong and the Lin Clan reach the Imperial City; Lin Fan warns him about Wang Zhong.
Wang Zhong and Wang Yan provoke Lin Dong, and Wang Lei taunts Lin Fan about the Wang Clan's win twenty years ago.
Emperor Mo Jingtian announces five places for the Hundred Dynasties Battle and a draw into five groups.
Lin Dong draws Wang Zhong's group and defeats Huangpu Ying.
Wang Zhong fights with the Blood Demonic Asura Spear; Lin Dong counters with the Heavy Prison Peak.
Lin Dong beats Wang Zhong's Blood Demon attack with four fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Mo Ling, Lin Langtian, Du Yun, Man Shan and Lin Dong take the five places.
The emperor grants the winners training in the Sacred Spirit Pool.
cultivation: Emperor Mo Jingtian is judged to be One Yuan Nirvana, stronger than Lin Fan and Wang Lei. Wang Zhong is Manifestation peak.

title: The Ancient Heavenly Crocodile
summary: In the Sacred Spirit Pool, Lin Dong and Little Mink sense the remains of an Ancient Heavenly Crocodile at the bottom and dive for its essence blood, though the emperor has forbidden it. Lin Langtian follows, and the Yuan Spirit inside him fights Little Mink until the sealing formation breaks and Lin Langtian leaves Lin Dong to die. Lin Dong falls into an earth-fire vent, where the crocodile's remnant soul wakes in its skeleton. He distracts it while Little Mink drags the soul out and devours it, and Lin Dong takes the crocodile's bone spear Soul Treasure and essence blood. On the surface Lin Langtian has blamed him, but the emperor believes Lin Dong and lets him keep the spear. Little Flame starts evolving on the crocodile blood, and Ling Qingzhu's master sends her to the Ancient Battlefield.
events: The emperor sends the five into the Sacred Spirit Pool and forbids them to go to the bottom.
Lin Dong feels his Ancient Dragon Ape essence blood grow, and Little Mink senses a beast stronger than Nirvana below.
At the bottom Lin Langtian attacks; his inner Yuan Spirit fights Little Mink with the Energy Gathering Technique.
Lin Langtian's Great Heavenly Phoenix Seal meets Lin Dong's Great Desolate Ocean Splitting Seal and the formation breaks.
Lin Dong falls into an earth-fire vent and fights the crocodile skeleton with the Heavenly Scales Halberd Art.
Little Mink pulls out the remnant soul and absorbs it with Devouring Power; Lin Dong finds the crocodile's bone spear.
Lin Langtian blames Lin Dong; the emperor tells the crocodile's history and lets Lin Dong keep the spear.
Little Flame absorbs the crocodile blood, and Ling Qingzhu is sent to look into strange activity in the Ancient Battlefield.
cultivation: Little Mink says the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile was beyond Nirvana. Demon beasts that enter Nirvana and survive the Nirvana Tribulation can take human form. Little Flame begins evolving after taking the crocodile's essence blood.

title: Yang City
summary: The five Great Yan contestants are sent into the Ancient Battlefield, where they must survive for a year. Only those who reach Nirvana may go on to compete for places in the super sects. Demon beasts there carry Nirvana Pills, but at night the energy turns into evil qi that weakens humans and strengthens beasts. The group shelters in Yang City, a ruin held by the Holy Light Dynasty, whose Jin Mu charges ten Nirvana Pills to enter and kills those who refuse. A beast tide strikes at night, and Lin Dong saves Mu Hongling. Jin Mu then demands half of everyone's pills, and Lin Dong refuses to kneel. A second, larger tide comes, and Jin Mu secretly orders Xia Huang to get rid of Lin Dong.
events: Mo Jingtian sends the five off and tells Mo Ling to make friends with Lin Dong.
Mo Ling explains the one-year rule and that only Nirvana experts may go further in.
The group kills a pack of beasts and finds Nirvana Pills inside them.
Holy Light Dynasty guards under Jin Mu charge ten Nirvana Pills to enter Yang City and kill those who resist.
Little Mink shields Lin Dong from the evil qi, while Lin Langtian's inner spirit does the same for him.
In the night's beast tide Lin Dong saves Mu Hongling.
Jin Mu demands half the pills; Lin Dong refuses to kneel, and a second, larger tide arrives.
Jin Mu splits the defence over three walls and orders Xia Huang to kill Lin Dong.
cultivation: Jin Mu is Half-step Nirvana. In the Ancient Battlefield only those who reach Nirvana may compete for places in the super sects.

title: The Second Wall
summary: On the second wall Lin Dong and Little Flame charge out into the beast tide while Xia Huang's men hold back. A huge pressure then rolls in from a demon beast of at least Nine Yuan Nirvana, and a swarm of insects drives the defenders back. Xia Huang's men try to take Lin Dong's Soul Treasure, and he fights through them. An Earth Demon Scorpion at Manifestation peak attacks the wall. Lin Dong's Blood Spirit Puppet goes wild on the evil qi, so he recalls it with the Stone Talisman and kills the scorpion with the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. Ling Qingzhu kills the Nine Yuan Nirvana beast and finds that someone was driving it with a seal. When the tide ends, the Holy Light Dynasty strikes down Du Yun and Man Shan to take the Nirvana Pills, and Lin Dong steps up to fight Jin Mu.
events: Lin Dong and Little Flame charge into the beasts outside the wall.
A Nine Yuan Nirvana beast's pressure is felt, and an insect swarm breaks the first wall.
Xia Huang's men try to seize Lin Dong's Soul Treasure; he fights them off and returns to the second wall.
The Blood Spirit Puppet runs wild absorbing evil qi; Lin Dong takes it back with the Stone Talisman.
Lin Dong kills the Earth Demon Scorpion with the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, and Little Flame eats its Nirvana Pill.
Ling Qingzhu kills the Nine Yuan Nirvana beast and records the seal used to drive it.
The Holy Light Dynasty attacks Du Yun and Man Shan for the spoils, and Lin Dong faces Jin Mu.
cultivation: The beast behind the tide is at least Nine Yuan Nirvana. The Earth Demon Scorpion is at Manifestation peak.

title: Five Fingers and a Golden Body
summary: Lin Dong fights Jin Mu with the Demon Ape Transformation, while Jin Mu answers with the Holy Light Demon-Subduing Staff and the Saint Elephant Sky Crumbling Tackle. Lin Dong wins with four fingers, but Jin Mu traps him in the Holy Light Formation. Lin Dong uses five fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger for the first time and breaks it, and the Holy Light disciples flee. Lin Langtian then attacks the exhausted Lin Dong, but a strange power stops him and he leaves with a threat. Ling Qingzhu meets Yuan Cang, the Little Yuan King, and tells him the Nirvana beasts were all marked with Beast-Driving Seals. Lin Dong worries that five fingers is still too much for him. Little Mink gives him the Lesser Nirvana Golden Body and spends about ten thousand Nirvana Pills to help him forge a Nirvana Golden Body.
events: Lin Dong uses the Demon Ape Transformation against Jin Mu's Holy Light Demon-Subduing Staff.
Jin Mu's Saint Elephant Sky Crumbling Tackle loses to four fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Jin Mu traps Lin Dong in the Holy Light Formation; Lin Dong breaks it with five fingers and the Holy Light disciples flee.
Lin Langtian attacks Lin Dong and Little Flame, is stopped by a strange force, and leaves vowing to kill him.
Ling Qingzhu meets Yuan Cang and says someone planted Beast-Driving Seals in many Nirvana beasts.
A hidden group reports that the super sects have taken the bait.
Lin Dong practises Jin Mu's Saint Elephant Sky Crumbling Tackle.
Little Mink teaches him the Lesser Nirvana Golden Body, using up the Nirvana Pills, and Lin Dong forms the Nirvana Golden Body.
cultivation: Jin Mu is Half-step Nirvana. Lin Dong uses five fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger for the first time but struggles to control it. He forges the Nirvana Golden Body with the Lesser Nirvana Golden Body, a Manifestation-grade body art.

title: Leiyan Valley
summary: Ling Qingzhu and Yuan Cang track down an intruder from the Western Xuan Region, who blows himself up rather than answer. In Yang City, Mu Hongling tells Lin Dong and Mo Ling about an ancient treasure in Leiyan Valley that includes a Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, which can lift a Spirit Symbol Master to Heaven Symbol Master. They go together, though Little Mink warns that she is hiding something. In the valley the Demon Rock Dynasty's Chen Mu drives off Hua Yun of the Xuanbing Dynasty. Lin Dong pushes past Hua Yun's men with the Nirvana Golden Body and five fingers, and Hua Yun lets him in, planning to strike later for the Ancient Secret Key. Inside, Lin Dong and Little Flame search the lower level for the tree, and the ground starts to shake.
events: A Western Xuan Region intruder attacks Yuan Cang and Ling Qingzhu and blows himself up.
Lin Dong returns to Yang City, where Mo Ling asks to be called by name.
Mu Hongling invites them to Leiyan Valley for the treasure and the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree.
At the valley Chen Mu of the Demon Rock Dynasty forces Hua Yun of the Xuanbing Dynasty to withdraw.
Lin Dong fights Hua Yun with the Nirvana Golden Body and five fingers, and Hua Yun lets him through.
Hua Yun reveals the Xuanbing Dynasty's goal is the Ancient Secret Key.
Lin Dong and Little Flame go to the lower level while Mo Ling and Mu Hongling search above; an earthquake strikes.
cultivation: Lin Dong is at Manifestation peak. Chen Mu and Hua Yun are both Nirvana experts.

title: The Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree
summary: Lin Dong finds the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, but its symbol spirit fights him off. Li Pan, a Nirvana expert of the Demon Rock Dynasty, claims the tree, and Lin Dong snatches it during the fight and escapes behind the Nirvana Golden Body. He meets Mo Ling and Mu Hongling, and they hide in a chamber whose Yuan Essence Power formation holds what looks like the Ancient Secret Key, though Lin Dong thinks it is too easy. When Chen Mu, Li Pan and the Xuanbing Dynasty arrive, Lin Dong throws a key to Hua Yun to set them against each other. The hall's statues then wake as Nirvana-level stone puppets, and Lin Dong sends his friends away. Little Mink smells the real key inside one statue.
events: Lin Dong finds the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, but its symbol spirit drives him back.
Li Pan of the Demon Rock Dynasty claims the tree; Lin Dong takes it during the fight.
Lin Dong holds off Li Pan with the Nirvana Golden Body and escapes with Little Flame.
Mo Ling and Mu Hongling join him, and they hide from Demon Rock guards.
They find a Yuan Essence Power formation holding what looks like the Ancient Secret Key.
Chen Mu, Li Pan and Hua Yun's group corner them; Lin Dong throws the key to Hua Yun and the two dynasties fight.
The statues wake as stone puppets; Lin Dong sends Mo Ling and Mu Hongling away and stays.
Little Mink smells the real Ancient Secret Key inside a statue.
cultivation: Li Pan is a Nirvana expert. The stone puppets are at least Nirvana.

title: A Heaven Symbol Master
summary: Lin Dong smashes the statue and takes the real Ancient Secret Key, while the Demon Rock Dynasty captures Mo Ling outside. The key carries Lin Dong into a separate space, where Mu Hongling reveals her hidden strength and admits she used him. She subdues the Blood Spirit Puppet and Little Flame and takes the key, but the key sends her away. Lin Dong then refines the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, and the remnant soul of the key's former owner tries to take his body. Little Mink tears it apart with devouring power, and Lin Dong becomes a Heaven Symbol Master. Little Mink reminds him of his promise to help restore Little Mink's true body.
events: Lin Dong and Little Flame break the statue and get the real Ancient Secret Key.
Mu Hongling attacks, and the Demon Rock Dynasty captures Mo Ling.
The key carries Lin Dong into a separate space where Mu Hongling confronts him.
Mu Hongling admits using him, beats the Blood Spirit Puppet and Little Flame, and takes the key.
The key absorbs Lin Dong's Yuan Power and sends Mu Hongling away.
Lin Dong refines the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree; the old remnant soul tries to seize his body.
Little Mink destroys the remnant soul with devouring power, and Lin Dong becomes a Heaven Symbol Master.
introduced: remnant soul of the key's owner
cultivation: Lin Dong refines the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree and becomes a Heaven Symbol Master.

title: The Prisoner Exchange
summary: Lin Dong finds Mo Ling's sword with a message: bring the Ancient Secret Key to Demon Rock City within five days or Mo Ling dies. Chen Mu sends Li Pan to hunt a Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger in the Demon Forest, and Lin Dong traps Li Pan's group behind a mental barrier only a Heaven Symbol Master could make. He offers to swap them for Mo Ling. At the exchange Chen Mu offers him a guest elder post for the key, then attacks once Mo Ling is free, and Lin Dong beats him with the Wind Thunder Seal. Then Shi Xuan, a One Yuan Nirvana expert who had hidden his aura, steps in. Lin Dong fights him with the Saint Elephant Sky Crumbling Tackle and the Demon Ape Transformation, but Shi Xuan proves stronger.
events: Lin Dong finds Mo Ling's sword and the Demon Rock Dynasty's demand.
Mo Ling refuses to reveal his group's camp; Chen Mu sends Li Pan after a Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger.
Lin Dong seals Li Pan's group behind a mental barrier and captures them.
A freed disciple carries Lin Dong's offer to swap Li Pan's group for Mo Ling.
Chen Mu brings Mo Ling without telling Shi Xuan, who is in seclusion.
After the swap Chen Mu attacks, and Lin Dong beats him with the Wind Thunder Seal.
Shi Xuan, One Yuan Nirvana, reveals himself and overpowers Lin Dong.
cultivation: Shi Xuan is One Yuan Nirvana. Lin Dong is now a Heaven Symbol Master and can make a mental barrier.

title: The Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger
summary: Lin Dong hits Shi Xuan with five fingers of the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger, but Shi Xuan's counter leaves Little Flame badly hurt, and the Ancient Secret Key teleports them back to Yang City. Little Mink says only the essence blood of a related tiger can save Little Flame, so Lin Dong goes after the One Yuan Nirvana Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger in the Demon Forest. On Little Mink's advice he combines Mental Strength with Devouring Power and creates the Devouring Thunder Palm. The tiger can speak and hates humans because the Demon Rock Dynasty killed its cubs, but it agrees to give its blood. The blood carries the Heavenly Demonic Tiger bloodline, which will either take Little Flame into Nirvana or kill him. Little Flame begins to absorb it, and Shi Xuan tracks them down.
events: Lin Dong's five fingers cannot finish Shi Xuan, whose seal badly wounds Little Flame.
The Ancient Secret Key teleports the group back to Yang City.
Little Mink says Little Flame needs blood from a tiger of a related bloodline.
Lin Dong leaves Mo Ling in Yang City and goes to the Demon Forest.
He fights the One Yuan Nirvana tiger and invents the Devouring Thunder Palm.
The tiger speaks, angry about its slain cubs, and agrees to help Little Flame.
Its blood carries the Heavenly Demonic Tiger bloodline; Little Flame starts to absorb it.
Shi Xuan finds Lin Dong's hiding place.
cultivation: The Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger is One Yuan Nirvana. If Little Flame fuses its Heavenly Demonic Tiger bloodline, he will heal and leap into Nirvana; if he fails he dies.

title: Lin Yan
summary: Demon Rock Dynasty disciples arrive, and Lin Dong leads them away while Little Flame keeps absorbing the tiger's blood. Shi Xuan sees through the trick and turns back, so Lin Dong races after him. Lin Dong throws everything at Shi Xuan, the Demon Ape Transformation, the Wind Thunder Seal, five fingers and the Devouring Thunder Palm, but is beaten down. Then the Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger steps in, and Little Flame returns in human form, and together they finish Shi Xuan. Little Flame has passed the Nirvana Tribulation. Lin Dong names him Lin Yan and they become sworn brothers, with Little Mink insisting on being the eldest. The Demon Rock Dynasty's senior brother learns that Lin Dong killed Shi Xuan and took the key, and puts a bounty of one million Nirvana Pills on him.
events: The Demon Rock pursuers arrive; Lin Dong draws them away from Little Flame.
Shi Xuan stops the chase and heads back to Little Flame.
Lin Dong fights Shi Xuan with every technique he has and is overwhelmed.
The Mighty Earthsplitting Tiger joins in, and Little Flame appears in human form to defend him.
Shi Xuan is killed.
Little Flame has passed the Nirvana Tribulation; Lin Dong names him Lin Yan and they swear brotherhood with Little Mink.
The Demon Rock Dynasty offers one million Nirvana Pills for Lin Dong, dead or alive.
cultivation: Little Flame passes the Nirvana Tribulation, enters Nirvana and takes human form. Shi Xuan was One Yuan Nirvana.

title: The Pill River
summary: Lin Dong learns there are four Ancient Secret Keys, and Mo Ling parts ways so he will not slow them down. Lin Dong robs the Sky Eagle Dynasty men who come for his bounty, while Lin Yan fights with a staff technique from Little Mink, and learns the other keys are held by the Youquan, Primordial and Demon Rock dynasties. Little Mink leads them to a ruined clan site, where the Stone Talisman repairs its formation and shuts Wang Lie of the Sky Eagle Dynasty outside. Inside is a river of Nirvana Pills, and Lin Dong dives straight into his Nirvana Tribulation. Wang Lie returns with Zheng Hei Zhu and Chen Ku, all One Yuan Nirvana, and breaks in. By then Lin Dong has passed the tribulation, and he beats all three with five fingers and leaves as One Yuan Nirvana.
events: Lin Dong hears there are four Ancient Secret Keys; Mo Ling leaves the group.
Sky Eagle Dynasty men attack for the Demon Rock bounty; Lin Yan fights with Little Mink's staff technique.
The captives say the other keys belong to the Youquan, Primordial and Demon Rock dynasties.
Little Mink finds a ruined clan site, and the Stone Talisman repairs its formation.
Wang Lie of the Sky Eagle Dynasty is shut out behind the sealed stone gate.
Inside, a river of Nirvana Pills; Lin Dong starts his Nirvana Tribulation at once.
Wang Lie, Zheng Hei Zhu and Chen Ku break in; Lin Dong, through the tribulation, beats them with five fingers.
The site collapses, and Lin Dong leaves as One Yuan Nirvana.
cultivation: Lin Dong starts at Half-step Nirvana, passes the Nirvana Tribulation in the Pill River and reaches One Yuan Nirvana. Wang Lie, Zheng Hei Zhu and Chen Ku are each One Yuan Nirvana.

title: The Fourth Key Holder
summary: The holders of the four Ancient Keys gather at the Ancient Treasure Trove on the Ancient Battlefield. Shi Kun of the Demon Rock Dynasty has put a bounty of a million Nirvana Pills on Lin Dong, and Hong Lie of the Primordial Dynasty says he has found a powerful ally. Lin Dong arrives with Little Flame and Little Mink as the fourth key holder. Shi Kun attacks him to avenge his brother Shi Xuan, and Lin Dong holds his own with Yuan Essence Power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger. You Qing stops the fight, and the four keys open the treasure, the ruins of a vast ancient sect. Little Mink leads Lin Dong to the pill chamber, where Yan Sen and others are fighting over the pills. Little Mink spots a Life and Death Reincarnation Pill that could rebuild his body, and Lin Dong decides to take it.
events: Shi Kun and Hong Lie wait at the treasure; Shi Kun has offered a million Nirvana Pills for Lin Dong.
Lin Dong arrives with Little Flame as the fourth Ancient Secret Key holder.
Shi Kun, Two Yuan Nirvana peak, attacks Lin Dong over his brother Shi Xuan's death.
Lin Dong fights back with Yuan Essence Power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
You Qing and Hong Lie call a halt, and the four keys open the Ancient Treasure Trove.
The groups split up; Hong Lie's hooded ally has an aura Lin Dong finds familiar.
In the pill chamber Little Mink spots the Life and Death Reincarnation Pill, which could rebuild his body.
Lin Dong and Little Flame go after the pill.
cultivation: Lin Dong is One Yuan Nirvana and a Heaven Symbol Master. Shi Kun is at the peak of Two Yuan Nirvana.

title: The Life and Death Reincarnation Pill
summary: Lin Dong snatches the Life and Death Reincarnation Pill from the furnace in the pill chamber while Yan Sen's group fights for it. The furnace is coated with the power of death, and a black mist hurts those who grab at it. Little Mink says restarting the furnace could clear the death power, so Lin Dong and Little Flame start its mechanism. Lin Dong dives through the furnace's spirit fire, protected by the Stone Talisman, seizes the pill, and escapes with Devouring Thunder Palm. Little Mink says refining a body from the pill will take months, so they press on. They reach the ruins of a Tiangang Alliance sect that is guarded by a shifting formation. There they meet Mu Sha of the Youquan Dynasty. Lin Dong turns down his offer to work together, and Mu Sha swears to make him pay.
events: Lin Dong cuts in on Yan Sen's fight over the pill furnace.
The death power on the furnace strikes those who reach for it.
Lin Dong and Little Flame restart the furnace through its mechanism.
Lin Dong seizes the Life and Death Reincarnation Pill through the spirit fire and escapes.
Little Mink says he needs months to rebuild his body from it.
They enter a Tiangang Alliance sect's ruins, where the entrance vanishes behind them.
Mu Sha of the Youquan Dynasty offers a partnership; Lin Dong refuses.
cultivation: Mu Sha is a Heaven Symbol Master.

title: The Eight Extremes Sect
summary: Spirits chase Lin Dong, Little Flame and Little Mink through the ruins into a hall full of stone statues. Lin Dong hears voices and links his Mental Strength with the statues. He learns that this was the Eight Extremes Sect, whose disciples fought the same monsters seen in the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet. They turned themselves to stone to power the Nirvana Heaven-Burning Array, with one statue as its core. Brute force fails, but the Stone Talisman breaks the core and the array ends. Mu Sha then ambushes them and uses a Spirit Driving Art to control the statues. When Lin Dong presses him, the formation's end wakes the sect's guardian beast, a Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, and Mu Sha seizes control of it.
events: Spirits chase the group into a dead end and then a hall of stone statues.
Lin Dong's Mental Strength links with the statues and shows him the Eight Extremes Sect's last battle.
The disciples sacrificed themselves to the Nirvana Heaven-Burning Array.
The Stone Talisman breaks the array's core statue and frees the sect's disciples.
Mu Sha ambushes them and drives the statues with a Spirit Driving Art.
Lin Dong attacks Mu Sha directly, since he can use only one Mental Strength skill at a time.
A Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, the sect's guardian beast, wakes and Mu Sha takes control of it.

title: The Trial of Eight Extremes
summary: Mu Sha cannot fully control the Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, because its remnant soul fights his Spirit Driving Art. Lin Dong and Little Flame push him harder, and he dies after burning out his Mental Strength. Little Mink calms the hound with his demon power as a Celestial Demon Marten, and takes its last wisp of soul with them. Behind the stone gate Lin Dong finds the Eight Extremes Sect's manuals and a trial left by an old master's remnant will. The remnant attacks him, and Little Mink tells him to take its palm strike and absorb it into his Yuan Dan. Lin Dong suppresses the energy with his Great Sun Thunder Body. Meanwhile Shi Kun's men find Mu Sha's body and send for Shi Kun.
events: The hound's remnant soul resists Mu Sha's control.
Mu Sha burns out his Mental Strength and dies.
Little Mink tames the Primordial Demon Dragon Hound and takes its remnant soul.
Behind the stone gate is a hall of Eight Extremes manuals and the Eight Extremes True Meaning.
An old master's remnant will tests Lin Dong with attacks that ordinary means cannot touch.
Lin Dong absorbs the master's palm strike into his Yuan Dan and suppresses it with the Great Sun Thunder Body.
Shi Kun's men find Mu Sha's body and report to Shi Kun.

title: Shi Kun Falls
summary: Shi Kun's group reaches the Eight Extremes Sect gate, where Little Flame stands guard alone and is badly beaten. Inside, Lin Dong survives the remnant master's final move with Little Mink's help. He comes out having learned the spiritual martial art Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand. He overpowers Shi Kun and kills him with it, then takes his Ancient Secret Key. Little Mink heals Little Flame with pills from Lin Dong's Qiankun Bag. The Ancient Keys then point the way to the Four Sect Halls, where every dynasty gathers before bronze gates. Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing accuse Lin Dong of theft and murder and demand his two keys and the pill. Lin Dong refuses and dares Lin Langtian to fight him one on one.
events: Shi Kun's men attack Little Flame, who refuses to let anyone through the gate.
Lin Dong takes the remnant master's last move and masters the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand.
Lin Dong overwhelms Shi Kun and kills him.
Little Mink heals Little Flame with pills from the Qiankun Bag.
The Ancient Keys lead everyone to the bronze gates of the Four Sect Halls.
The gates react to Lin Dong's two keys; Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing demand them.
Lin Dong refuses and challenges Lin Langtian to fight alone.
cultivation: Lin Dong gains the spiritual martial art Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand. Shi Kun was at the peak of Two Yuan Nirvana when Lin Dong killed him.

title: The Green Dragon Hall
summary: Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing attack Lin Dong together, and Little Flame is hurt blocking Lin Langtian. Little Mink gives Lin Dong the Demon Dragon Hound's demon soul, and he uses it to summon the true soul of the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile, which crushes Hong Lie and You Qing. Lin Dong beats Lin Langtian's spiritual martial art with the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand, but Lin Langtian flees. Behind the bronze gate is the Green Dragon Hall, where the remnant shadow of Qing Zhi, the Green Dragon King, tests Lin Dong. Qing Zhi learns that Hei Tong passed on the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and gives Lin Dong the Green Heaven Materialized Dragon Skill. After three months in the hall's pill store, Lin Dong reaches Three Yuan Nirvana, and Little Mink regains a body in human form. On the way out an elder of a Super Sect sends them to Wanxiang City.
events: Lin Langtian, Hong Lie and You Qing attack Lin Dong together; Little Flame is hurt.
Lin Dong uses the hound's demon soul to summon the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile's true soul.
Lin Dong defeats Lin Langtian's spiritual martial art, and Lin Langtian flees crying to a Master Mu for help.
In the Green Dragon Hall, Qing Zhi's remnant shadow tests Lin Dong with Heavenly Dragon Energy.
Qing Zhi gives him the Green Heaven Materialized Dragon Skill out of regard for Hei Tong.
Three months later Lin Dong breaks through to Two and then Three Yuan Nirvana.
Little Mink rebuilds his body in human form; Little Flame returns stronger.
An elder sends them to Wanxiang City, the Super Sects' selection ground.
cultivation: Lin Dong breaks through to Two Yuan Nirvana and then Three Yuan Nirvana after three months in the pill store. Little Mink restores his physical body in human form.

title: The Hundred Dynasties Battle Begins
summary: The dying Lin Langtian refuses to accept defeat, and a mysterious figure offers him longer life and power if he cooperates. At Wanxiang City Lin Dong saves Su Rou of the Daqing Dynasty from Fengyun Dynasty men who want the inheritance inside her. Little Mink warns that the power in her could run wild at any time. The final stage of the Hundred Dynasties Battle begins with a test at the Nirvana Monument. Lin Dong, Lin Diao and Lin Yan take second, third and fourth in the Earth tier, while Super Dynasty fighters start in the Heaven tier with 100 points. The top 24 after three days will climb Baichao Mountain, so Lin Dong goes after Super Dynasty fighters for their Nirvana Seals. He finds Feng Cang's men hunting Su Rou again and fights Feng Cang, who is at the peak of Four Yuan Nirvana. Feng Cang brings out the Heaven-grade Soul Treasure Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal.
events: A mysterious voice offers the dying Lin Langtian life and power in return for cooperation.
Lin Dong saves Su Rou from Fengyun Dynasty men who want her inheritance.
The Nirvana Monument test gives out Heaven, Earth and Human tier Nirvana Seals.
Lin Dong, Lin Diao and Lin Yan take second to fourth place in the Earth tier.
Feng Cang of the Fengyun Dynasty mocks the lower dynasties for complaining about the rules.
The battle opens: the top 24 after three days will climb Baichao Mountain.
Lin Dong rescues Su Rou from Feng Cang's group and fights Feng Cang.
Feng Cang brings out the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal.
cultivation: Lin Dong is Three Yuan Nirvana. Feng Cang is at the peak of Four Yuan Nirvana. Onlookers judge Lin Dong's two brothers to have Four Yuan Nirvana strength.

title: Feng Cang Falls
summary: Lin Dong faces Feng Cang's Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal with the Green Heaven Materialized Dragon Skill's scale shield and Immovable Bell, then kills him. He takes the seal and Feng Cang's Nirvana Seal and jumps from the Earth tier to the Heaven tier. Super Sect elders, among them Liu Tong of the Yuan Gate and Wu Dao of the Dao Sect, take notice. Qin Tian of the Tianyuan Dynasty, first in the Heaven tier, gives the injured Lin Dong medicine and warns him about the Three Song Devils. Su Rou joins the group, and Lin Dong hides in a cave to heal and break through. A Death Spirit General from the Western Xuan Region attacks to silence them, and Little Mink and Little Flame hold him off. Su Rou opens her inheritance's second seal to protect Lin Dong, who comes out and strikes with the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal.
events: Lin Dong blocks the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal with the Green Dragon scale shield and Immovable Bell.
Lin Dong kills Feng Cang and takes the seal and his Nirvana Seal.
Lin Dong rises to the Heaven tier; Super Sect elders watch.
Su Rou offers her seals in thanks and joins Lin Dong, Lin Diao and Lin Yan.
Qin Tian gives Lin Dong medicine and promises to fight him on Baichao Mountain.
A Death Spirit General of the Western Xuan Region attacks while Lin Dong breaks through in a cave.
Su Rou opens her inheritance's second seal to defend Lin Dong.
Lin Dong comes out and uses the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal on the attackers.
cultivation: Lin Dong is Three Yuan Nirvana. Qin Tian is Six Yuan Nirvana. The Death Spirit General is Five Yuan Nirvana. Su Rou can now bear two layers of her inheritance's seals. Lin Dong's breakthrough attempt in the cave is cut short.

title: Four Yuan Nirvana
summary: Lin Dong and his brothers wreck the Death Spirit General's body with the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal, but his soul escapes. The general reports to his master, who meets Lin Langtian and tells him a bigger task awaits. Lin Dong saves Mo Ling of the Great Yan Dynasty from Heavenly Demon Dynasty disciples. Mo Ling warns that the Three Song Devils are Five Yuan Nirvana and that Lin Langtian has grown stronger and stranger. Little Flame starts his Nirvana tribulation, and Lin Dong's group guards him when the Three Song Devils arrive for Su Rou's inheritance. Su Rou opens her second seal, and Lin Dong takes on Song Zhen. Lin Dong goes through his own tribulation mid-fight and reaches Four Yuan Nirvana. Song Zhen calls on his Taotie and the Four Demonic Sects' devouring inheritance, but Lin Dong answers with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol's power.
events: The Death Spirit General's body is destroyed by the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal; his soul flees.
His master meets Lin Langtian, who offers to kill Lin Dong's group.
Lin Dong saves Mo Ling from Heavenly Demon Dynasty disciples.
Mo Ling warns them about the Three Song Devils and the changed Lin Langtian.
Little Flame begins his Nirvana tribulation while the others guard him.
Song Que, Song Zhen and Song Ba arrive and demand Su Rou's inheritance.
Lin Dong breaks through to Four Yuan Nirvana in the middle of fighting Song Zhen.
Song Zhen summons his Taotie; Lin Dong counters with Devouring Power.
cultivation: Lin Dong breaks through to Four Yuan Nirvana during a Nirvana tribulation in battle. The Three Song Devils are Five Yuan Nirvana. Little Flame begins his own Nirvana tribulation. The Death Spirit General is Five Yuan Nirvana.

title: Lin Dong Versus Lin Langtian
summary: Lin Dong turns the Taotie's devouring back on Song Zhen and defeats him, and the brothers take the Song brothers' Nirvana Seals. Lin Dong rises to eighth place, and the top 24 teleport to Baichao Mountain. There Wu Dao's clone asks Lin Dong to join the Dao Sect, and Lin Dong asks for time to think. Liu Tong of the Yuan Gate explains the Nirvana Ranking battle, where the top three may choose their sect and past champions have all joined the Yuan Gate. The first-round draw pits Lin Dong against Lin Langtian. Lin Langtian lets a primordial spirit inside him merge with him and takes a Yimo form with ancient Yimo martial arts. Lin Dong holds him off with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol's power and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Hand.
events: Lin Dong devours Song Zhen's power and defeats him.
With the Song brothers' seals Lin Dong rises to eighth and reaches the final 24.
The finalists teleport to Baichao Mountain, while Western Xuan agents prepare their plan.
Wu Dao's clone invites Lin Dong to join the Dao Sect.
Liu Tong explains the rules: any means, life or death not counted.
The draw sets Lin Dong against Lin Langtian.
Lin Langtian merges with a primordial spirit and fights with Yimo martial arts.
Lin Dong counters with Devouring Power and the Great Desolate martial spirit.
cultivation: Lin Langtian merges with a primordial spirit awakened inside him and takes a Yimo form, multiplying his strength.

title: The Western Xuan Plot
summary: Lin Langtian burns his primordial spirit to fuel his martial spirit, but Lin Dong blocks him with the Green Dragon Immovable Bell. Lin Dong taunts him into striking the bell, using that force to summon the Green Dragon's spirit and take dragon form. Remembering how Lin Langtian crippled his father, Lin Dong overwhelms him. Losing, Lin Langtian crushes a token and triggers a hidden formation that seals Baichao Mountain in a Space Prison. Zheng Zhong of the Western Xuan Region appears before Liu Tong of the Yuan Gate. His Heaven-Sealing Formation Diagram is pulling the whole Ancient Battlefield toward the Western Xuan Region. The Death Spirit General returns stronger, kills three Five Yuan Nirvana fighters at once, and orders everyone to submit as pill slaves.
events: Lin Langtian sacrifices his primordial spirit to power his martial spirit.
Lin Dong blocks with the Green Dragon Immovable Bell and goads Lin Langtian into ringing it.
The bell calls the Green Dragon spirit, and Lin Dong takes dragon form.
Lin Dong overwhelms Lin Langtian, remembering his crippled father.
Lin Langtian crushes a token and sets off a hidden formation over the mountain.
Zheng Zhong of the Western Xuan Region reveals a plan to move the Ancient Battlefield west.
The Heaven-Sealing Formation Diagram cuts the mountain off from the outside.
The revived Death Spirit General kills three Five Yuan Nirvana fighters and demands surrender.
cultivation: The revived Death Spirit General is at least Seven Yuan Nirvana. One of the fighters who attacks the Western Xuan side is Six Yuan Nirvana.

title: Champion of the Hundred Dynasties
summary: Lin Dong decides to destroy the core of the Heaven-Sealing Formation Diagram. He fights the revived Death Spirit General with Little Flame's help and passes three wind and thunder tribulations, rising from 1st Seal to 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master. Using the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and the Stone Talisman, he takes in the tribulation lightning, then turns it and the Black Dragon Sky-Roaring Seal on the formation core. The others join in, and to cover them Lin Dong strikes the wisp of Zheng Zhong's primordial spirit with Heavenly Dragon Energy. Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace arrives, and Zheng Zhong retreats. The Super Sects make Lin Dong champion, and he turns down the Yuan Gate to join the Dao Sect. A month later the Lin Clan honours Lin Zhentian and the Yan City branch.
events: Lin Dong goes after the formation core and fights the Death Spirit General.
He passes three wind and thunder tribulations and becomes a 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master.
He takes in the lightning with the Devouring Ancestral Symbol and the Stone Talisman and breaks the core.
Everyone attacks the core; Lin Dong strikes Zheng Zhong's primordial spirit to break the Space Prison.
Ling Qingzhu of the Nine Heavens Taiqing Palace drives Zheng Zhong off.
Lin Dong is named champion and chooses the Dao Sect over the Yuan Gate.
The Lin Clan raises Lin Zhentian to Supreme Elder and honours the Yan City branch.
cultivation: Lin Dong passes three wind and thunder tribulations and rises from 1st Seal to 2nd, 3rd and then 4th Seal Heaven Symbol Master. Zheng Zhong is at the Profound Life stage.
